text: EX-10.1 2 ef20086445_ex10-1.htm EXHIBIT 10.1 Exhibit 10.1 Amendment to 2025 Performance Award Agreement Under the Thryv Holdings, Inc. 2020 Incentive Award Plan This Amendment (this “ Amendment ”) to the 2025 Performance Award Agreement, dated as of January 6, 2025 (the “ Award Agreement ”), by and between Thryv Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the “ Company ”), and [Participant Name] (the “ Participant ”), is adopted by the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors of the Company (the “ Committee ”), effective as of November 24, 2026 (the “ Amendment Date ”). Capitalized terms used but not defined herein have the meanings ascribed thereto in the Award Agreement or, if not defined therein, the Thryv Holdings, Inc. 2020 Incentive Award Plan (as amended from time to time, the “ Plan ”). WHEREAS, the Company has granted performance-based Restricted Stock Units (the “ PSUs ”) to the Participant pursuant to the Award Agreement and the Plan; WHEREAS, pursuant to Section 9(f) of the Plan and Section 17(b) of the Award Agreement, the Committee may amend the terms of the Award Agreement, subject to the limitations set forth therein; and WHEREAS, the Committee has determined that this Amendment is favorable to the Participant and desires to amend the performance conditions applicable to a portion of the PSUs without changing the existing vesting and settlement provisions. NOW, THEREFORE, pursuant to its authority under the Award Agreement and the Plan, the Committee hereby amends the Award Agreement as follows: 1. Amendment to Award Agreement . Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in Section 2 of the Award Agreement or Appendix I thereto, effective as of the Amendment Date, the number of PSUs earned under the Award Agreement shall be determined as follows: a. Allocation of Target PSUs . The target number of PSUs specified in the Award Agreement (the “ Target PSUs ”) shall be divided into two portions. The “ Original Portion ” shall equal the Target PSUs multiplied by a fraction, the numerator of which is the number of calendar days from January 1, 2025 through and including the Amendment Date and the denominator of which is 1095, rounded down to the nearest whole PSU. The “ Amended Portion ” shall equal the Target PSUs minus the Original Portion, so that the Original Portion and the Amended Portion together equal the Target PSUs. The performance period remains January 1, 2025 through December 31, 2027 (the “ Performance Period ”). b. Original Portion . The payout percentage applicable to the Original Portion (the “ Original Payout Percentage ”) shall equal the sum of (i) 30% of the payout percentage determined for relative total shareholder return, (ii) 30% of the payout percentage determined for absolute total shareholder return and (iii) 40% of the payout percentage determined for SaaS Revenue CAGR, in each case under the terms of the Award applicable immediately before the Amendment Date, except as expressly modified herein. Solely for purposes of clauses (i) and (ii), the applicable measurement period shall begin on January 1, 2025 and end on the Amendment Date, using the original starting prices and, for relative total shareholder return, the original Performance Peer Group applicable to the Award immediately before the Amendment Date. For clause (iii), SaaS Revenue CAGR shall continue to be measured over the full Performance Period. The performance hurdles, payout levels and other calculation provisions applicable to each such metric under the Award immediately before the Amendment Date shall continue to apply, except as expressly modified by this Amendment. c. Amended Portion . The payout percentage applicable to the Amended Portion (the “ Amended Payout Percentage ”) shall be determined solely by SaaS Revenue CAGR, weighted at 100%, measured over the full Performance Period. SaaS Revenue CAGR shall be determined using the same methodology, performance hurdles, payout levels and other calculation provisions applicable to the SaaS Revenue CAGR component of the Award immediately before the Amendment Date, except that such metric shall be weighted at 100% for the Amended Portion. Relative total shareholder return and absolute total shareholder return shall not apply to the Amended Portion. d. Earned PSUs; Certification . Subject to Section 3 of the Award Agreement, the total number of PSUs earned shall equal the sum of (i) the Original Portion multiplied by the Original Payout Percentage and (ii) the Amended Portion multiplied by the Amended Payout Percentage, with the aggregate result rounded down to the nearest whole PSU, notwithstanding any provision of the Award Agreement or Appendix I requiring rounding to the nearest whole PSU. Any service-based proration required by Section 3 of the Award Agreement shall be applied before the final number of earned PSUs is rounded down to the nearest whole PSU. The Committee shall certify both payout percentages and the number of earned PSUs following completion of the Performance Period in accordance with Section 2(b) of the Award Agreement. e. Existing Award Provisions . The allocation described above is solely for purposes of calculating performance-based payouts and does not create separate grants or independently vested awards. Section 3 of the Award Agreement, including any service-based proration, forfeiture and change-in-control provisions, remains unchanged. To the extent Section 3 requires a determination based on actual performance, that determination shall reflect the performance conditions as modified by this Amendment; existing target-performance protections remain unchanged. The applicable vesting, settlement and tax withholding provisions, including Sections 3, 4 and 8 of the Award Agreement, continue to apply without modification, except as expressly provided in this Amendment. 2. Miscellaneous . a. Effect on Award Agreement . Except as specifically amended by this Amendment, the Award Agreement and the Plan remain in full force and effect and are hereby ratified and confirmed. The PSUs are not canceled or replaced. This Amendment controls in the event of any conflict with the Award Agreement or Appendix I concerning the matters expressly amended herein; the Plan continues to control in the event of a conflict with the Plan. b. Effectiveness . This Amendment is effective on the Amendment Date upon approval by the Committee and does not require the Participant’s execution or consent. Any acknowledgment of receipt requested from the Participant is for administrative purposes only and is not a condition to effectiveness. c. Governing Law . This Amendment shall be governed by and construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to conflict of law principles thereof that would give effect to the law of another state. d. Headings . Headings are used solely for convenience and shall not be deemed to limit or describe the content of any provision of this Amendment. e. Further Amendments . The Award Agreement, as amended hereby, may be further amended in accordance with Section 17(b) of the Award Agreement and the Plan. [ Signature Page Follows ] IN WITNESS WHEREOF, upon authorization of the Committee, the Company has executed this Amendment as of the Amendment Date. THRYV HOLDINGS, INC. By: Name: Title:

text: EX-10.2 6 tm2630512d1_ex10-2.htm EXHIBIT 10.2 Exhibit 10.2 LOCK-UP AND LEAK-OUT AGREEMENT THIS LOCK-UP AND LEAK-OUT AGREEMENT (this "Agreement") is made and entered into as of November 22, 2026, by and between GridAI Technologies Corp., a Delaware corporation ("PubCo"), and the undersigned holder (the "Holder"), a member of Pronghorn Resources LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Pronghorn"). RECITALS (A) PubCo, Pronghorn, the members of Pronghorn (collectively, the "Sellers") and the Agent are parties to that certain Share Exchange Agreement, dated as of November 12, 2026 (as amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time, the "Share Exchange Agreement"), pursuant to which the Sellers will exchange all of the outstanding Units of Pronghorn for the Exchanged Common Shares and the Exchanged Preferred Shares. (B) Section 5.19 of the Share Exchange Agreement requires each Seller to execute and deliver to PubCo, at or prior to the Closing, a lock-up agreement restricting the transfer of the Exchanged Shares and the Exchanged Conversion Shares for a period of thirty (30) months following the Closing Date, subject to the release provisions set forth herein and any leak-out arrangements that PubCo and the Holder may agree to in writing in the future. (C) The Holder acknowledges that the execution, delivery and performance of this Agreement is a material inducement to PubCo to enter into the Share Exchange Agreement and to consummate the transactions contemplated thereby, and that the Holder will directly benefit from such transactions. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing and the mutual covenants herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties agree as follows: 1. Definitions 1.1 Capitalized terms used but not defined herein have the meanings given to them in the Share Exchange Agreement. In addition: (i) "Daily Trading Volume" means, for any Trading Day, the aggregate number of shares of PubCo Common Stock traded on the Trading Market on such Trading Day, as reported by Bloomberg, L.P. (or, if not reported by Bloomberg, L.P., another reputable source reasonably designated by PubCo). (ii) "Leak-Out Agreement" means any written agreement entered into by PubCo and the Holder after the date hereof that expressly permits the sale or other Transfer of Lock-Up Securities, on the terms and subject to the conditions set forth therein, as the same may be amended from time to time. (iii) "Lock-Up Period" means the period commencing on the Closing Date and ending on the thirty (30) month anniversary of the Closing Date. (iv) "Lock-Up Securities" means (i) the Exchanged Common Shares and the Exchanged Preferred Shares (including any Escrow Shares, if and when released to the Holder) issued to the Holder under the Share Exchange Agreement, (ii) all Exchanged Conversion Shares and other shares of PubCo Common Stock issued or issuable upon conversion of such Exchanged Preferred Shares, including any additional shares of Series I Preferred Stock or PubCo Common Stock resulting from any adjustment under Section 7 of the Series I Certificate of Designation, and (iii) any securities issued in respect of any of the foregoing by way of stock split, stock dividend, recapitalization, reclassification, merger, exchange or similar event. Page 1 (v) "Pro Rata Share" means, as to the Holder, the percentage set forth opposite the Holder's name in the column captioned “Percentage Ownership” on Schedule A to the Share Exchange Agreement, which the parties agree constitutes the Holder’s Pro Rata Portion for all purposes of this Agreement. (vi) "Sigma9 Lock-Up Agreement" means the lock-up agreement entered into by and between Sigma9 Capital Ltd., a Cayman Islands exempted company ("Sigma9"), and PubCo in connection with that certain Assignment and Assumption Agreement (Amended and Restated Joint Venture Agreement – Wyoming Energy Generation Platform), dated on or about the date hereof, by and between Sigma9 and PubCo (the "Sigma9 Assignment and Assumption Agreement"), on terms substantially identical to the terms of this Agreement, as the same may be amended from time to time in accordance with Section 6.3. (vii) "Trading Day" means a day on which the Trading Market is open for trading, and "Trading Market" means the Nasdaq Capital Market or such other national securities exchange or market on which the PubCo Common Stock is then principally listed or quoted. (viii) "Transfer" means to, directly or indirectly, (i) offer, sell, contract to sell, pledge, hypothecate, grant any option, right or warrant to purchase, lend, make any short sale or otherwise transfer or dispose of any Lock-Up Securities, (ii) enter into any swap, hedge, derivative or other arrangement that transfers to another, in whole or in part, any of the economic consequences of ownership of any Lock-Up Securities, whether settled in securities, cash or otherwise, (iii) establish or increase a put equivalent position or liquidate or decrease a call equivalent position within the meaning of Section 16 of the Exchange Act with respect to any Lock-Up Securities, or (iv) publicly announce any intention to do any of the foregoing. 2. Lock-Up 2.1 During the Lock-Up Period, the Holder shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates and any Person in privity with the Holder not to, Transfer any Lock-Up Securities, except as expressly permitted by Section 4. 2.2 The restrictions in this Section 2 expressly preclude the Holder from engaging in any hedging or other transaction designed to, or which reasonably could be expected to, lead to or result in a sale or disposition of Lock-Up Securities, even if such Lock-Up Securities would be disposed of by a Person other than the Holder. 2.3 Notwithstanding Sections 2.1 and 2.2, the Holder may sell or otherwise Transfer Lock-Up Securities during the Lock-Up Period to the extent, and only in the manner, expressly permitted under any Leak-Out Agreement then in effect. Page 2 2.4 Notwithstanding Section 2.1, the Holder may establish a trading plan pursuant to Rule 10b5-1 under the Exchange Act during the Lock-Up Period, provided that (a) no sales are made under such plan during the Lock-Up Period except as expressly permitted under a Leak-Out Agreement, (b) all sales under such plan comply with any applicable Leak-Out Agreement, (c) the Holder delivers a copy of such plan to PubCo promptly following its adoption, and (d) no public announcement or filing is required or voluntarily made in connection with such plan during the Lock-Up Period. 2.5 Nothing in this Agreement restricts the conversion of Exchanged Preferred Shares into PubCo Common Stock in accordance with the Series I Certificate of Designation; provided that the shares of PubCo Common Stock received upon such conversion shall constitute Lock-Up Securities subject to this Agreement. 3. Leak-Out 3.1 PubCo and the Holder may, from time to time following the date hereof, enter into one or more Leak-Out Agreements. Any sale or other Transfer of Lock-Up Securities made in compliance with a Leak-Out Agreement shall be permitted under this Agreement, and in the event of any conflict between this Agreement and a Leak-Out Agreement with respect to such sales or Transfers, the Leak-Out Agreement shall control. Except as expressly set forth in a Leak-Out Agreement, nothing in this Section 3 shall limit the restrictions set forth in Section 2, and no party shall be obligated to enter into any Leak-Out Agreement. 3.2 Upon the expiration of the Lock-Up Period, the Lock-Up Securities shall be released from the restrictions of this Agreement, subject to any Leak-Out Agreement then in effect and applicable securities laws. 4. Permitted Transfers 4.1 Notwithstanding Sections 2 and 3, the Holder may Transfer Lock-Up Securities: (i) as a bona fide gift or gifts, or by will or the laws of descent and distribution upon the death of the Holder; (ii) to a trust, family limited partnership or similar entity for the direct or indirect benefit of the Holder or the immediate family of the Holder (meaning any relationship by blood, marriage, domestic partnership or adoption, not more remote than first cousin), provided that such Transfer does not involve a disposition for value; (iii) if the Holder is an entity, to any Affiliate of the Holder or as a distribution to its members, partners or stockholders, provided that such Transfer does not involve a disposition for value; (iv) in one or more private transactions not effected through the Trading Market, with the prior written consent of PubCo (not to be unreasonably withheld), provided that the sale is effected in accordance with applicable securities laws and, if requested by PubCo, the Holder delivers an opinion of counsel reasonably acceptable to PubCo to that effect; Page 3 (v) to PubCo in satisfaction of indemnification obligations under Article VIII of the Share Exchange Agreement, including any forfeiture or cancellation of Escrow Shares; or (vi) pursuant to a bona fide tender offer, merger, consolidation or other similar transaction approved by the board of directors of PubCo and made to all holders of PubCo Common Stock involving a Change of Control (as defined below), provided that if such transaction is not completed, the Lock-Up Securities shall remain subject to this Agreement; 4.2 provided, that in the case of each of clauses (i) through (iv) of Section 4.1, the transferee agrees in writing, in form reasonably satisfactory to PubCo, to be bound by the terms of this Agreement for the remainder of the Lock-Up Period and by any Leak-Out Agreement then in effect, and any Lock-Up Securities so transferred shall count against any volume or other sale limitations applicable to the Holder under such Leak-Out Agreement, which shall be shared between the Holder and such transferee. 5. Enforcement 5.1 The Holder consents to the entry of stop-transfer instructions with PubCo's transfer agent and registrar against the Transfer of the Lock-Up Securities except in compliance with this Agreement, and to the placement of a legend on the Lock-Up Securities referencing this Agreement. 5.2 Any purported Transfer in violation of this Agreement shall be null and void ab initio, and PubCo shall not be required to register any such Transfer on its books. 5.3 If the Holder sells Lock-Up Securities in violation of this Agreement or any Leak-Out Agreement, PubCo shall be entitled to recover from the Holder an amount equal to the profits realized by the Holder on such sales (measured as the gross proceeds of such sales less the Holder's tax basis in such Lock-Up Securities), and the Holder agrees that such remedy is not a penalty but is reasonable compensation commensurate with the harm to PubCo and its stockholders. Such remedy is in addition to, and not in lieu of, PubCo's right to specific performance and injunctive relief under Section 8.3. 6. Termination 6.1 This Agreement shall terminate upon the earliest to occur of (a) the expiration of the Lock-Up Period, (b) the valid termination of the Share Exchange Agreement prior to the Closing, (c) the consummation of a Change of Control, and (d) the mutual written agreement of PubCo and the Holder. 6.2 "Change of Control" means (i) a merger or consolidation of PubCo with or into another Person in which PubCo is not the surviving entity, (ii) a sale of all or substantially all of the assets of PubCo, or (iii) the acquisition by any Person or group (other than the Sellers) of beneficial ownership of more than fifty percent (50%) of the outstanding voting securities of PubCo. Page 4 6.3 Parity with Sigma9 and Other Sellers. (a) If PubCo waives, releases, amends or terminates, in whole or in part, any restriction under the Sigma9 Lock-Up Agreement or under the lock-up agreement of any other Seller (including any early release or release of a percentage or number of the securities subject thereto, or pursuant to any Leak-Out Agreement (as defined therein)), then the same waiver, release, amendment or termination shall automatically, and without any further action by any Person, apply to the Holder and the Lock-Up Securities on a pro rata basis (determined by reference to the percentage of the securities subject to such other lock-up agreement so released) and on the same terms and conditions. (b) PubCo shall not amend, modify or supplement the Sigma9 Lock-Up Agreement on terms more favorable to Sigma9 than the terms of this Agreement are to the Holder unless PubCo concurrently offers the same terms to the Holder in writing, and upon the Holder's acceptance thereof this Agreement shall be deemed amended to incorporate such terms. (c) PubCo shall give the Holder prompt written notice (and in any event within two (2) Trading Days) of any waiver, release, amendment or termination described in this Section 6.3, describing in reasonable detail its terms and the number and percentage of securities released; provided that any failure to give such notice shall not affect the automatic application of Section 6.3(a). 6.4 Sections 5, 6.3, 6.4 and 8, and any liability for a breach of this Agreement occurring prior to termination shall survive any termination of this Agreement. 7. Representations of the Holder 7.1 The Holder represents and warrants that (a) it has full power and authority (or, if an individual, legal capacity) to execute, deliver and perform this Agreement, (b) this Agreement constitutes a legal, valid and binding obligation of the Holder enforceable in accordance with its terms, subject to applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganization, moratorium and similar laws affecting creditors' rights generally and general principles of equity, and (c) upon issuance, the Holder will have good and marketable title to the Lock-Up Securities, free and clear of all liens other than those created by this Agreement, the Share Exchange Agreement or applicable securities laws. 7.2 The Holder acknowledges that sales permitted under this Agreement or any Leak-Out Agreement remain subject to applicable federal and state securities laws, including Rule 144, Regulation M, Section 16 of the Exchange Act and PubCo's insider trading policy, to the extent applicable, and that nothing in this Agreement constitutes a representation by PubCo that any Lock-Up Securities are or will be registered or eligible for resale. 8. Miscellaneous 8.1 Governing Law; Jurisdiction. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the internal laws of the State of Delaware, without giving effect to any choice or conflict of law provision or rule. Any action arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall be brought in accordance with Section 10.10 of the Share Exchange Agreement, which is incorporated herein by reference, mutatis mutandis. EACH PARTY IRREVOCABLY WAIVES ANY RIGHT TO TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY ACTION ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT. Page 5 8.2 Notices. All notices hereunder shall be given in the manner set forth in Section 10.02 of the Share Exchange Agreement, to PubCo at its address set forth therein and to the Holder at the address set forth on its signature page hereto. 8.3 Specific Performance. The Holder agrees that irreparable damage would occur if this Agreement were not performed in accordance with its terms, and that PubCo shall be entitled to an injunction, specific performance and other equitable relief, without the posting of any bond, in addition to any other remedy at law or in equity. 8.4 Amendment and Waiver. This Agreement may be amended or waived only by a written instrument signed by PubCo (acting with the approval of a majority of its board of directors) and the Holder; provided that following the Closing, any amendment that applies to the Sellers generally shall require the consent of the Agent; provided, further, that any waiver, release or amendment that applies automatically pursuant to Section 6.3 shall be effective without any such instrument or consent. 8.5 Successors and Assigns. This Agreement is irrevocable and shall be binding upon the Holder and its heirs, legal representatives, successors and permitted assigns. The Holder may not assign this Agreement except to a permitted transferee under Section 4. 8.6 Effectiveness. This Agreement shall become effective upon the Closing and shall be of no force or effect if the Closing does not occur. 8.7 Severability; Counterparts. If any provision hereof is held invalid or unenforceable, it shall be modified to the minimum extent necessary to render it enforceable, and the remaining provisions shall remain in full force. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, including by electronic signature or .pdf, each of which shall be deemed an original. 8.8 Entire Agreement. This Agreement, together with the Share Exchange Agreement and the other Ancillary Documents, constitutes the entire agreement of the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof. In the event of any conflict between this Agreement and Section 5.19 of the Share Exchange Agreement or the Registration Rights Agreement, this Agreement shall control. [Signature Page Follows] Page 6 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Lock-Up and Leak-Out Agreement as of the date first written above. GRIDAI TECHNOLOGIES CORP. HOLDER: By: By: Name: Jason D. Sawyer Name: Title: Chief Executive Officer Title: Address: E-mail: Page 7

text: EX-10.3 7 tm2630512d1_ex10-3.htm EXHIBIT 10.3 Exhibit 10.3 PRONGHORN STOCKHOLDER VOTING AGREEMENT This Voting Agreement (this “ Agreement ”) is made and entered into as of November November 22, 2026, by and between GridAI Technologies Corp., a Delaware corporation (“ PubCo ”), and the undersigned member of Pronghorn Resources LLC the “ Stockholder ”). PubCo and the Stockholder are each sometimes referred to herein as a “ Party ” and collectively as the “ Parties ”. RECITALS WHEREAS, concurrently with the execution hereof, Pronghorn Resources LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (“ Pronghorn ”), PubCo, and the members of Pronghorn (collectively, the “ Sellers ”) are entering into a Share Exchange Agreement (as the same may be amended from time to time, the “ Share Exchange Agreement ”), pursuant to which, among other things, the Sellers will exchange all of the outstanding membership units of Pronghorn for shares of Series I Convertible Preferred Stock (the “ Series I Preferred Stock ”) of PubCo (the “ Share Exchange ”); WHEREAS, as of the date hereof, the Stockholder is the record and beneficial owner (as defined in Rule 13d-3 under the Exchange Act) of certain units of Pronghorn and will, as a result of the Share Exchange, receive certain shares of Series I Preferred Stock which is convertible into common stock of PubCo, par value $0.0001 per share (“ PubCo Common Stock ”), of which such Stockholder will be the record and beneficial owner of (all such shares of Series I Preferred Stock and PubCo Common Stock that are hereafter issued to such Stockholder in connection with the Share Exchange and the conversion of any Series I Preferred Stock being referred to herein as the “ Covered Shares ”), provided , however , that, when used with respect to voting or consenting by or in the name of the Stockholder or any other Person acting on the Stockholder’s behalf hereunder with respect to PubCo Common Stock, the term “Covered Shares” shall only include the securities that are entitled to be voted (in a particular general or class vote of the stockholders), or for which the Stockholder or any other Person acting on such Stockholder’s behalf is entitled to consent (in a particular general or class vote of the stockholders), with respect thereto (which, for the avoidance of doubt, shall not include unissued shares of PubCo Common Stock that are subject to future issuance upon the conversion of Series I Preferred Stock unless such shares are entitled to vote on any such shareholder matters), and nothing herein shall affirmatively require (and no Stockholder undertakes any obligation or makes any representation or warranty related to) the conversion, exercise or exchange of any security into securities entitled to be voted (in a particular general or class vote of the stockholders), or for which such Stockholder is entitled to consent or act (in a particular general or class vote of the stockholders), with respect thereto; and WHEREAS, as a condition to the willingness of Pronghorn and the Sellers to enter into the Share Exchange Agreement, and as a material inducement and in consideration therefor, the Stockholder has entered into this Agreement. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing and the representations, warranties, covenants and agreements set forth herein, and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are acknowledged, the Parties, intending to be legally bound, agree as follows: 1. Definitions . Capitalized terms used but not otherwise defined herein shall have the respective meanings ascribed to such terms in the Share Exchange Agreement. As used in this Agreement, the following terms have the meanings set forth below: “ Adjustment ” means any stock (or share) split (including a reverse stock (or share) split), stock (or share) dividend or distribution, merger, reorganization, recapitalization, reclassification, combination, exchange of shares or similar transaction with respect to the capital stock (or share capital) of PubCo. “ Affiliates ” shall mean, with respect to any Person, any other Person that directly or indirectly controls or is controlled by or is under common control with such Person. “ Expiration Time ” means the earliest of (a) ten years from the date hereof, (b) the valid termination of the Share Exchange Agreement in accordance with its terms prior to the Closing, (c) with respect to any Covered Shares, the Transfer of such Covered Shares pursuant to a registration statement or similar trading market transaction to any non-affiliated purchaser of the Stockholder, and (d) the first date on which the Sellers collectively beneficially own less than forty percent (40%) of PubCo Common Stock, calculated on an as-converted basis by treating all shares of Series I Preferred Stock then held by the Sellers as converted into PubCo Common Stock (without regard to any beneficial ownership conversion limitation) and including in the denominator all issued and outstanding shares of PubCo Common Stock and all shares of PubCo Common Stock issuable upon conversion of outstanding preferred stock of PubCo, without duplication. “ Transfer ” shall mean any direct or indirect (i) sale, tender, exchange, assignment, encumbrance, gift, hedge, pledge, hypothecation, disposition or other transfer (by operation of Law or otherwise), voluntarily or involuntarily, or entry into any contract, option or other arrangement or understanding with respect to any sale, tender, exchange, assignment, encumbrance, gift, hedge, pledge, hypothecation, disposition or other transfer (by operation of Law or otherwise), of any Covered Shares (excluding, for the avoidance of doubt, any sale, tender, exchange, assignment, encumbrance, gift, hedge, pledge, hypothecation, disposition or other transfer pursuant to this Agreement or the Share Exchange Agreement) or any right, title or interest therein; (ii) (x) deposit of any Covered Shares into a voting trust, (y) entry into a support agreement with respect to any Covered Shares (other than this Agreement), or (z) grant of any irrevocable or revocable proxy, corporate representative appointment or power of attorney (or other consent or authorization with respect to any Covered Shares) with respect to any Covered Shares (other than as set forth in this Agreement); or (iii) any agreement or commitment (whether or not in writing) to take any of the actions referred to in the foregoing clauses (i) or (ii). 2. Agreement to Vote . (a) Agreement to Vote . From the date hereof until the Expiration Time, the Stockholder irrevocably and unconditionally agrees that, at every meeting of the stockholders or of any class of stockholders of PubCo, however called, including any adjournment or postponement thereof, and in connection with any action proposed to be taken by written consent of the stockholders or any class of stockholders of PubCo, such Stockholder shall, in each case, to the fullest extent that such Stockholder’s Covered Shares are entitled to vote thereon: (a) appear at each such meeting or otherwise cause all such Covered Shares to be counted as present thereat for the purpose of determining a quorum; and (b) be present (in person or by proxy) and vote (or cause to be voted), or deliver (or cause to be delivered) a written consent with respect to, all such Covered Shares in favor of the slate of director nominees proposed by PubCo. 2 (b) Other Actions . From the date hereof until the Expiration Time, the Stockholder irrevocably and unconditionally agrees not to take any action, whether by voting or by written consent or otherwise, to (i) remove any of PubCo’s directors then serving, (ii) to increase the number of directors of PubCo and vote for any such additional directors, in each case of clauses (i) and (ii), except as necessary to give effect to the board designation, replacement and composition rights expressly provided in Section 5.10 of the Share Exchange Agreement or to address the removal of a director for cause, or (iii) adopt, approve or vote in favor of any amendment, modification, restatement or repeal of, or addition to, the bylaws of PubCo (or any corresponding provision of the certificate of incorporation of PubCo) that would amend, modify, eliminate or otherwise affect the provisions governing the nomination or election of directors, advance notice of stockholder nominations or proposals, the size or composition of the board of directors of PubCo, the filling of vacancies or newly created directorships, or the removal of directors, unless such amendment, modification, restatement, repeal or addition has been approved by the board of directors of PubCo. (c) PubCo Compliance with Board Designation Rights . Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, the obligations of the Stockholder under this Section 2 (including the irrevocable proxy granted under Section 2.1) are expressly subject to PubCo’s compliance with Section 5.10 of the Share Exchange Agreement. If PubCo fails to comply with Section 5.10 of the Share Exchange Agreement, including by failing to include the Sellers’ designees in PubCo’s slate of director nominees as required thereby, then, for so long as such failure continues, the Stockholder shall not be bound by this Section 2 and shall be free to vote the Covered Shares in its sole discretion. 2.2 Irrevocable Proxy . The Stockholder hereby appoints PubCo and any designee of PubCo, and each of them individually, until the Expiration Time (at which time this proxy shall automatically be revoked), its proxies and attorneys-in-fact, with full power of substitution and resubstitution, to vote during the term of this Agreement with respect to the Covered Shares solely in accordance with Section 2(a) , and subject in all respects to Section 2(c). This proxy and power of attorney is given to secure the performance of the duties of the Stockholder under this Agreement. The Stockholder shall take such further action or execute such other instruments as may be necessary to effectuate the intent of this proxy. This proxy and power of attorney granted by the Stockholder shall be irrevocable during the term of this Agreement, shall be deemed to be coupled with an interest sufficient in Law to support an irrevocable proxy, and shall revoke any and all prior proxies granted by such Stockholder with respect to the Covered Shares. The power of attorney granted by the Stockholder herein is a durable power of attorney and shall survive the bankruptcy, death, or incapacity of such Stockholder. 2.3 Notice of Certain Events . The Stockholder agrees to notify PubCo of any development occurring after the date hereof that causes, or that would reasonably be expected to cause, any material breach of any of the representations and warranties of the Stockholder set forth in Section 3 . PubCo shall notify the Stockholder of any development occurring after the date hereof that causes, or that would reasonably be expected to cause, any material breach of any of the representations and warranties of PubCo set forth in Section 6 . 3 3. Representations and Warranties of the Stockholder . The Stockholder represents and warrants to PubCo that: 3.1 Due Organization; Authority . (a) If the Stockholder is not an individual, (i) the Stockholder is duly organized, validly existing and in good standing (to the extent such concept is recognized under applicable Law) under the Law of its jurisdiction of incorporation or organization, as applicable, (ii) the Stockholder has the requisite power and authority to enter into and to perform its obligations under this Agreement, (iii) the execution and delivery of this Agreement by the Stockholder and the performance of its obligations hereunder and the consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby have been duly authorized by all necessary action on the part of the Stockholder, and (iv) no other proceedings on the part of the Stockholder are necessary to authorize the execution, delivery and performance of this Agreement by the Stockholder or to consummate the transactions contemplated hereby. If the Stockholder is an individual, the Stockholder has the requisite legal capacity, right and authority to execute, deliver and perform the Stockholder’s obligations under this Agreement and to consummate the transactions contemplated hereby. (b) This Agreement has been duly and validly executed and delivered by the Stockholder and, assuming the due authorization, execution and delivery by PubCo, constitutes a legal, valid and binding obligation of the Stockholder, enforceable against the Stockholder in accordance with its terms, subject to the Enforceability Limitations. 3.2 Ownership of the Covered Shares; Voting Power . Upon the closing of the Share Exchange, the Stockholder is the record and beneficial owner (as defined in Rule 13d-3 under the Exchange Act) of all of the Covered Shares and has good and marketable title to all of the Covered Shares free and clear of any lien, charge, pledge, security interest, claim, adverse ownership interest, or agreements, options, rights, understandings or arrangements or any other encumbrances or restrictions whatsoever on title, transfer or exercise of any rights of a stockholder in respect of the Covered Shares (collectively, “ Liens ”), other than those created by this Agreement or those imposed by applicable securities Law or for such Liens as would not prohibit, limit or otherwise conflict with the Stockholder’s compliance with its obligations pursuant to this Agreement (collectively, “ Permitted Liens ”). As of the date hereof, the Stockholder has not entered into any agreement to Transfer any of the Covered Shares. The Stockholder has full voting power with respect to all of the Covered Shares, and full power of disposition with respect to the Covered Shares, full power to issue instructions with respect to the matters set forth herein and full power to agree to all of the matters set forth in this Agreement, in each case with respect to all the Covered Shares. None of the Covered Shares are subject to any stockholders’ agreement, proxy, voting trust or other agreement, arrangement or Lien with respect to the voting of the Covered Shares, except as expressly provided herein (including Permitted Liens). 4 3.3 Non-Contravention; Consents . Neither the execution and delivery of this Agreement by the Stockholder nor the consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby nor compliance by the Stockholder with any provisions herein will (a) if the Stockholder is not an individual, violate, contravene or conflict with or result in any breach of any provision of the organizational documents of such Stockholder, (b) require any consent, approval, authorization or permit of, or filing with or notification to, any Governmental Entity on the part of the Stockholder, except for compliance with the applicable requirements of the Securities Act, the Exchange Act or any other securities laws and the rules and regulations promulgated thereunder, (c) violate, conflict with, or result in a breach of or default under any provisions of, or require any consent, waiver or approval under any of the terms, conditions or provisions of any material Contract to which the Stockholder is a party or by which the Stockholder or any of the Covered Shares may be bound, (d) result in the creation or imposition of any Lien (other than any Lien created by PubCo or the Permitted Liens) on any asset of the Stockholder or (e) violate any Law applicable to the Stockholder or by which any of the Covered Shares are bound, except, in the case of each of the clauses above, as would not, individually or in the aggregate, reasonably be expected to prevent, impair or materially delay the consummation by the Stockholder of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement or otherwise prevent, impair or materially delay the Stockholder’s ability to perform its obligations hereunder. 3.4 No Proceedings . As of the date hereof, there is no Proceeding pending against or, to the knowledge of the Stockholder, threatened against the Stockholder or any of the Stockholder’s properties or assets (including any of the Covered Shares) that would, individually or in the aggregate, reasonably be expected to prevent, impair or materially delay the consummation by the Stockholder of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement or otherwise prevent, impair or materially delay the Stockholder’s ability to perform its obligations hereunder. 3.5 Acknowledgment of the Terms and Conditions . The Stockholder has been represented by, or had the opportunity to be represented by independent counsel, and to the extent the Stockholder is not an individual, such Stockholder’s authorized officers have carefully read and fully understood this Agreement and the Share Exchange Agreement. 4. Termination . Unless earlier terminated by the mutual written consent of PubCo and the Stockholder, this Agreement shall terminate automatically and shall have no further force or effect as of the Expiration Time. Upon termination of this Agreement, no Party shall have any further obligations or liabilities under this Agreement; provided , however , that (i) nothing set forth in this Section 4 shall relieve any Party from liability for fraud or any willful breach of this Agreement prior to termination hereof and (ii) the provisions of this Section 4 and Section 6 shall survive any termination of this Agreement. In the event that the Share Exchange Agreement is validly terminated in accordance with its terms prior to the Closing, this Agreement shall automatically terminate. 5. Reliance . The Stockholder understands and acknowledges that PubCo is entering into the Share Exchange Agreement in reliance upon such Stockholder’s execution, delivery and performance of this Agreement. 5 6. Miscellaneous . 6.1 Severability . Any term or provision of this Agreement that is invalid or unenforceable in any situation in any jurisdiction shall not affect the validity or enforceability of the remaining terms and provisions hereof or the validity or enforceability of the offending term or provision in any other situation or in any other jurisdiction. If the final judgment of a court of competent jurisdiction declares that any term or provision hereof is invalid or unenforceable, the Parties agree that the court making such determination shall have the power to limit the term or provision, to delete specific words or phrases or to replace any invalid or unenforceable term or provision with a term or provision that is valid and enforceable and that comes closest to expressing the intention of the invalid or unenforceable term or provision, and this Agreement shall be enforceable as so modified. In the event such court does not exercise the power granted to it in the prior sentence, the Parties agree to replace such invalid or unenforceable term or provision with a valid and enforceable term or provision that will achieve, to the extent possible, the economic, business and other purposes of such invalid or unenforceable term. 6.2 Binding Effect and Assignment . Neither this Agreement nor any of the rights, interests or obligations hereunder shall be assigned by any Party (whether by operation of Law or otherwise) without the prior written consent of the other Party. Subject to the preceding sentence, this Agreement will be binding upon, inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by the Parties and their respective permitted successors and assigns. Any assignment in violation of this Section 6.2 shall be void. 6.3 Amendments and Waivers . Any provision of this Agreement may be amended, modified, supplemented or waived if, but only if, such amendment, modification, supplement or waiver is in writing and is signed, in the case of an amendment, modification or supplement by each Party to this Agreement or, in the case of a waiver, by each Party against whom the waiver is to be effective; provided, that following the Closing, no amendment, modification, supplement or waiver of any provision of this Agreement shall be effective without the prior written consent of the Agent (as defined in the Share Exchange Agreement). No failure or delay by any Party to assert any of its rights under this Agreement or otherwise shall constitute a waiver of such rights. 6.4 Specific Performance; Injunctive Relief . The Parties agree that irreparable injury, for which monetary damages (even if available) would not be an adequate remedy, will occur in the event that any of the provisions of this Agreement are not performed in accordance with their specific terms or are otherwise breached. Accordingly, it is agreed that each Party shall be entitled to an injunction or injunctions to prevent or remedy any breaches or threatened breaches of this Agreement by any other Party, a decree or order of specific performance specifically enforcing the terms and provisions of this Agreement and any further equitable relief, in each case in accordance with Section 6.6 , this being in addition to any other remedy to which such Party is entitled under the terms of this Agreement at law or in equity. The Parties’ rights in this Section 6.4 are an integral part of the transactions contemplated hereby and each Party hereby waives any objections to any remedy referred to in this Section 6.4 (including any objection on the basis that there is an adequate remedy at Law or that an award of such remedy is not an appropriate remedy for any reason at Law or equity). For the avoidance of doubt, each Party agrees that there is not an adequate remedy at Law for a breach of this Agreement by any Party. In the event any Party seeks any remedy referred to in this Section 6.4 , such Party shall not be required to obtain, furnish, post or provide any bond or other security in connection with or as a condition to obtaining any such remedy. 6 6.5 Notices . All notices, consents and other communications hereunder shall be in writing and shall be given in the manner described in Section 10.02 of the Share Exchange Agreement, addressed as follows: (i) if to PubCo, to its address or email address set forth in Section 10.02 of the Share Exchange Agreement, and (ii) if to the Stockholder, to such Stockholder’s address or email address set forth on a signature page hereto, or to such other address or email address as such Party may hereafter specify for the purpose by notice to each other Party hereto. 6.6 Applicable Law; Jurisdiction of Disputes . This Agreement and any dispute, controversy or claim arising out of, relating to or in connection with this Agreement shall be governed by and construed and enforced in accordance with the internal laws of the State of Delaware, without giving effect to any choice or conflict of law provision or rule (whether of the State of Delaware or any other jurisdiction). Any legal suit, action or proceeding arising out of or based upon this Agreement or the transactions contemplated hereby may be instituted in the federal courts of the United States of America or the courts of the State of New York, in each case located in the Borough of Manhattan, City and State of New York, and each Party irrevocably submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of such courts in any such suit, action or proceeding. Service of process, summons, notice or other document by mail to such Party’s address set forth herein shall be effective service of process for any suit, action or other proceeding brought in any such court. The Parties irrevocably and unconditionally waive any objection to the laying of venue of any suit, action or any proceeding in such courts and irrevocably waive and agree not to plead or claim in any such court that any such suit, action or proceeding brought in any such court has been brought in an inconvenient forum. 6.7 Waiver of Jury Trial . EACH PARTY HEREBY IRREVOCABLY AND UNCONDITIONALLY WAIVES ANY RIGHT IT MAY HAVE TO A TRIAL BY JURY IN RESPECT OF ANY LITIGATION DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT OR THE TRANSACTIONS CONTEMPLATED HEREBY. EACH PARTY CERTIFIES AND ACKNOWLEDGES THAT (A) NO REPRESENTATIVE, AGENT OR ATTORNEY OF ANY OTHER PARTY HAS REPRESENTED, EXPRESSLY OR OTHERWISE, THAT SUCH OTHER PARTY WOULD NOT, IN THE EVENT OF LITIGATION, SEEK TO ENFORCE SUCH WAIVERS, (B) IT UNDERSTANDS AND HAS CONSIDERED THE IMPLICATIONS OF SUCH WAIVERS, (C) IT MAKES SUCH WAIVERS VOLUNTARILY AND (D) IT HAS BEEN INDUCED TO ENTER INTO THIS AGREEMENT BY, AMONG OTHER THINGS, THE MUTUAL WAIVERS AND CERTIFICATIONS IN THIS SECTION 6.7 . 6.8 Entire Agreement . This Agreement, together with the Share Exchange Agreement, contains the entire understanding of the Parties in respect of the subject matter hereof, and supersedes all prior negotiations and understandings between the Parties with respect to such subject matter. 6.9 Counterparts . This Agreement may be executed manually or by other electronic transmission by the Parties, in any number of counterparts, each of which shall be considered one and the same agreement and shall become effective when a counterpart hereof shall have been signed by each of the Parties and delivered to the other Parties. The exchange of a fully executed Agreement (in counterparts or otherwise) by electronic transmission in .pdf or DocuSign format shall be sufficient to bind the Parties to the terms and conditions of this Agreement. 7 6.10 Interpretation . When a reference is made in this Agreement to sections, such reference shall be to a section of this Agreement, unless otherwise indicated. Whenever the words “include,” “includes” or “including” are used in this Agreement they shall be deemed to be followed by the words “without limitation.” The term “Affiliates” shall have the meaning set forth in the Share Exchange Agreement; provided, that no direct or indirect portfolio companies (as such term is understood in the private equity industry) or investments of or affiliated with the Stockholder or any of its Affiliates shall be deemed or treated as an Affiliate of such Stockholder. The word “extent” and the phrase “to the extent” when used in this Agreement shall mean the degree to which a subject or thing extends, and such word or phrase shall not merely mean “if.” The term “or” is not exclusive, and shall be interpreted as “and/or.” The phrases “the date of this Agreement,” “the date hereof,” “of even date herewith” and terms of similar import, shall be deemed to refer to the date set forth in the preamble to this Agreement. The headings set forth in this Agreement or any schedule delivered pursuant to this Agreement are for convenience of reference purposes only and shall not affect or be deemed to affect in any way the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement or such schedule or any term or provision hereof or thereof. All references herein to the Subsidiaries of a Person shall be deemed to include all direct and indirect Subsidiaries of such Person, unless otherwise indicated or the context otherwise requires. A reference to any specific Law or to any provision of any Law, whether or not followed by the phrase “as amended,” includes any amendment to, and any modification, re-enactment or successor thereof, any legislative provision substituted therefor and all rules, regulations and statutory instruments issued thereunder or pursuant thereto, except that, for purposes of any representations and warranties in this Agreement that are made as a specific date, references to any specific Law will be deemed to refer to such legislation or provision (and all rules, regulations and statutory instruments issued thereunder or pursuant thereto) as of such date. The Parties agree that they have been represented by counsel during the negotiation and execution of this Agreement and, therefore, waive the application of any Law, regulation, holding or rule of construction providing that ambiguities in an agreement or other document will be construed against the party drafting such agreement or document. 6.11 Capacity as Stockholder . No Person executing this Agreement who is or becomes an officer or director of PubCo makes any agreement or understanding herein in his or her capacity as such officer or director. The Stockholder signs solely in his, her or its capacity as the record and beneficial owner of the Covered Shares. Nothing herein shall limit or affect any actions taken by the Stockholder or any officer, director, employee, Affiliate or Representative of the Stockholder solely in his or her capacity as an officer or director of PubCo, including without limitation, exercising his or her fiduciary duties in connection therewith. 6.12 Adjustments . After the date of this Agreement and prior to the termination of this Agreement in accordance with Section 4 , in the event of an Adjustment, the term “Covered Shares” shall be deemed to refer to and include any stock (or share) and any securities into which or for which any or all of such stock (or share) and securities may be changed or exchanged or which are received in such Adjustment. 8 6.13 Expenses . All costs and expenses incurred in connection with this Agreement shall be paid by the Party incurring such cost or expense. 6.14 No Agreement Until Executed . This Agreement shall not be effective unless and until (i) the Share Exchange Agreement is executed and delivered by all parties thereto and (ii) this Agreement is executed and delivered by all Parties. 6.15 Further Assurances . The Stockholder will execute and deliver, or cause to be executed and delivered, all further documents and instruments and use such Stockholder’s reasonable best efforts to take, or cause to be taken, all actions and to do, or cause to be done, all things necessary, proper or advisable under applicable Law, to perform such Stockholder’s obligations under this Agreement. 6.16 No Third Party Beneficiaries . Except as expressly provided in this Section 6.16 , nothing in this Agreement shall confer any rights upon any Person other than the Parties and each such Party’s respective heirs, successors and permitted assigns. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Agent (as defined in the Share Exchange Agreement) is an intended third-party beneficiary of this Agreement and, following the Closing and until the Expiration Time, shall be entitled to enforce the provisions of this Agreement applicable to the Stockholder (including Sections 2 and 3) as if the Agent were a Party hereto, and to exercise the consent rights granted to the Agent under Section 4 and Section 6.3. Following the Closing, any enforcement of rights on behalf of Pronghorn or the Sellers under this Agreement with respect to the obligations of the Stockholder shall be conducted exclusively by the Agent. 6.17 Non-Survival of Representations and Warranties . The respective representations and warranties of the Stockholder and PubCo contained herein shall not survive Closing. 6.18 Non-Recourse . Notwithstanding anything herein to the contrary, this Agreement may only be enforced against, and any claim or cause of action based upon, arising out of, or to the extent related to this Agreement may only be brought against the entities that are expressly named as Parties hereto and their respective successors and assigns. Except as set forth in the immediately preceding sentence, no past, present or future director, officer, manager, employee, incorporator, member, partner, stockholder, equityholder, controlling person, Affiliate, agent, attorney, advisor or representative of any Party hereto, and no past, present or future director, officer, manager, employee, incorporator, member, partner, stockholder, equityholder, controlling person, Affiliate, agent, attorney, advisor or representative of any of the foregoing (each, a “ Non-Recourse Party ”) shall have any liability for any obligations or liabilities of any Party hereto under this Agreement (whether in tort, contract or otherwise). The Parties acknowledge and agree that the Non-Recourse Parties are third party beneficiaries of this Section 6.18 , each of whom may enforce the provisions thereof. 9 6.19 Several Obligations; No Group . The Stockholder acknowledges that PubCo is entering into separate support agreements with certain other members of Pronghorn. The obligations of the Stockholder under this Agreement are several and not joint with the obligations of any other Person, and the Stockholder shall not be responsible for the performance of any obligations of any other stockholder under any other agreement. Nothing contained in this Agreement or any other such support agreement, and no action taken by the Stockholder pursuant hereto, shall be deemed to constitute the Stockholder and any other Person as a partnership, association, joint venture or “group” (within the meaning of Section 13(d)(3) of the Exchange Act or Rule 13d-5 thereunder) with respect to any securities of PubCo, and the Stockholder has not agreed with any other stockholder of PubCo or member of Pronghorn to act together for the purpose of acquiring, holding, voting or disposing of any securities of PubCo. Except for the express obligations owed by the Stockholder to PubCo under this Agreement, the Stockholder shall independently exercise voting and dispositive authority over its Covered Shares, and this Agreement does not confer on the Stockholder any right to direct the voting or disposition of securities held by another stockholder. PubCo agrees that it shall not treat the Stockholder, any other party to a support agreement with PubCo, or any of their respective Affiliates as an “Attribution Party” (as defined in the Series I Certificate of Designation) for purposes of Section 6.3 of the Series I Certificate of Designation solely by reason of this Agreement or any such other support agreement; provided that the foregoing shall not limit the operation of applicable federal securities Laws or the application of Section 6.3 of the Series I Certificate of Designation where attribution is independently required thereunder. 10 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have executed this Voting Agreement as of the date first above written. text: EX-10.4 8 tm2630512d1_ex10-4.htm EXHIBIT 10.4 Exhibit 10.4 AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO THIRD AMENDED AND RESTATED SECURED CONVERTIBLE NOTE THIS AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO THIRD AMENDED AND RESTATED SECURED CONVERTIBLE NOTE (this " Amendment ") is entered into as of November 22, 2026, by and between PRONGHORN RESOURCES, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the " Company "), and GRIDAI TECHNOLOGIES CORP., a Delaware corporation (" GRID AI " or the " Holder "). RECITALS (A) the Company issued to the Holder that certain Third Amended and Restated Secured Convertible Note with an Issue Date of October 22, 2026, in the Principal Amount of $5,000,000 (the " Note "); (B) the Company, the members of the Company, Nick D’Onofrio, as representative of such members, and the Holder have entered into that certain Share Exchange Agreement dated as of November 12, 2026 (the " Share Exchange Agreement "), pursuant to which, among other things, the Holder will acquire all of the issued and outstanding membership units of the Company at the Closing (as defined in the Share Exchange Agreement); (C) Section 7.03(f) of the Share Exchange Agreement provides that it is a condition to the obligations of the Sellers (as defined therein) to consummate the Closing that the Holder shall have amended the Note so as to delete Section 4 thereof and any right of the Holder to convert the Note upon any default thereunder; (D) pursuant to Section 10 of the Note, the Note may be amended by a written instrument signed by the Company and the Holder; and (E) the Company and the Holder desire to amend the Note as set forth herein. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants herein and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties agree as follows: 1. Definitions 1.1 Capitalized terms used but not defined in this Amendment have the meanings given to them in the Note. 2. Elimination of Conversion Provisions 2.1 Effective as of, and contingent upon, the consummation of the Closing under the Share Exchange Agreement (the " Effective Time "), Section 4 (Conversion) of the Note, including all subsections thereof, is hereby deleted in its entirety and shall be null and void and of no further force or effect, and is replaced with the following: "Section 4. [Reserved]." 2.2 From and after the Effective Time, notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the Note, the Security Agreement or any other Transaction Document: (a) the Holder shall have no right, and the Company shall have no right or obligation, to convert all or any portion of the Note, the Payment Amount or the Default Amount into Conversion Interests or any other equity interest of the Company, whether upon an Event of Default or otherwise; (b) the Note shall be payable solely in cash in accordance with its terms; and (c) any election to convert delivered prior to the Effective Time that has not resulted in the issuance of Conversion Interests shall be deemed withdrawn and void. Page 1 3. Conforming Amendments 3.1 Effective as of the Effective Time, the Note is further amended as follows: (1) the definitions of "Conversion," "Conversion Amount," "Conversion Date," "Conversion Interests" and "Share Delivery Date" in Section 1 are deleted in their entirety; (2) clause (5) of the definition of "Default Amount" in Section 1 (beginning "minus (5) any dollar amount which has not been converted") is deleted in its entirety; (3) Section 2(b) is amended by deleting the words "if the Holder has not elected to convert this Note pursuant to Section 4(a), and the applicable Default Amount if the Holder has elected to convert a partial amount of this Note pursuant to Section 4(a)"; (4) the remedies provision of Section 8 (titled "Remedies Upon Event of Default") is amended by deleting the words ", and, alternatively, upon the Holder’s election, convertible, in part or in full, pursuant to the terms of Section 4(a)" and by deleting the words "or conversion" in the sentence beginning "Upon the payment or conversion in full"; (5) Section 8(a)(ii) is amended by deleting the parenthetical "(other than a breach by the Company of its obligations to deliver membership interests to the Holder upon conversion, which breach is addressed in clause (x) below)"; and (6) all references in Section 5 and elsewhere in the Note to the issuance, reservation or delivery of Conversion Interests, and all other references to conversion of the Note, shall be disregarded and of no force or effect. 3.2 The title of the Note and the legend thereon shall be read as referring to a "Secured Note," and references to securities into which the Note is convertible shall be of no further effect. 4. Termination 4.1 If the Share Exchange Agreement is terminated in accordance with its terms prior to the Closing, this Amendment shall automatically terminate and be of no force or effect, and the Note shall continue in full force and effect without giving effect to this Amendment. 5. Miscellaneous 5.1 Except as expressly amended hereby, the Note and the Security Agreement remain unmodified and in full force and effect, including the Holder’s security interest under the Security Agreement. From and after the Effective Time, each reference in the Note to "this Note" and each reference in any Transaction Document to the Note shall mean the Note as amended by this Amendment. Page 2 5.2 This Amendment constitutes a written instrument signed by the Company and the Holder for purposes of Section 10 of the Note. 5.3 This Amendment shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the internal laws of the State of New York, and Section 9(d) of the Note shall apply to this Amendment mutatis mutandis. 5.4 This Amendment may be executed in counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which together shall constitute one instrument. Signatures delivered by email (including PDF or any electronic signature complying with the U.S. federal ESIGN Act of 2000) shall be deemed original signatures. Assignor and Assignee are each a " Party " and together the " Parties ." This Agreement is the "Sigma9 Assignment and Assumption Agreement" referred to in the Series I Certificate of Designation and the Board Consent. Recitals WHEREAS , Assignor and FANCO are parties to that certain Amended and Restated Joint Venture Agreement, dated as of October 8, 2026 (the " JV Agreement "), which amended and restated in its entirety the Joint Venture Agreement between Assignor and FANCO dated June 3, 2026; WHEREAS , the JV Agreement defines "Grid AI" as "Grid AI, Inc., a Delaware corporation (NASDAQ: GRDX)" and contemplates that Assignor will assign the JV Agreement to Grid AI upon and concurrently with the closing of the transactions contemplated by the Pronghorn SEA (as defined below); the Parties acknowledge and agree that the entity so described is, and the "Grid AI" referred to in the JV Agreement shall be deemed to be, GridAI Technologies Corp., the Nasdaq-listed Delaware corporation that trades under the symbol "GRDX"; WHEREAS , Assignee is party to that certain Share Exchange Agreement, dated as of November 12, 2026 (as amended, the " Pronghorn SEA "), by and among Pronghorn Resources LLC, the members thereof and Assignee, pursuant to which Assignee will acquire Pronghorn Resources LLC and the Pronghorn Assets (the closing thereunder, the " Pronghorn Closing "); WHEREAS , Section 12.2(a) of the JV Agreement grants Assignor the express right, without any further consent of FANCO, to assign the JV Agreement and all of its rights and obligations thereunder to Grid AI only upon and concurrently with the Pronghorn Closing, and FANCO has irrevocably consented to such assignment and waived any advance-notice requirement applicable thereto; WHEREAS , Assignor desires to assign, and Assignee desires to accept and assume, the JV Agreement and all of Assignor's rights and obligations thereunder, in exchange for the issuance by Assignee to Assignor of shares of Assignee's Series I Convertible Preferred Stock, on the terms and subject to the conditions set forth herein. Reserved Matters, governance and board appointment rights, and all claims, causes of action and rights of recovery of Project Co. thereunder. Page 4 of 16 ARTICLE II – ASSIGNMENT AND ASSUMPTION Section 2.01 Assignment. Effective automatically upon and concurrently with the Pronghorn Closing (the " Assignment Date "), and subject to the satisfaction of the conditions in Article VII, Assignor hereby assigns, transfers, conveys and delivers to Assignee all of the Assigned Rights, free and clear of all Encumbrances, in accordance with Section 12.2 of the JV Agreement (the " Assignment "). The Parties acknowledge that, pursuant to Section 12.2(a) of the JV Agreement, the execution of this Agreement prior to the Assignment Date shall not itself constitute or cause the Assignment. Section 2.02 Assumption. Effective as of the Assignment Date, Assignee hereby accepts the Assignment and assumes in writing, and agrees to pay, perform and discharge when due, all of the obligations of "Project Co." under the JV Agreement (the " Assumed Obligations "), as required by Section 12.2(b)(i) of the JV Agreement. From and after the Assignment Date, Assignee shall be deemed "Project Co." for all purposes of the JV Agreement. Section 2.03 Retained Liabilities; Release. Notwithstanding Section 2.02, as between Assignor and Assignee, Assignor shall retain and remain responsible for, and shall indemnify Assignee against, any Liability of Project Co. under the JV Agreement to the extent arising out of any act, omission, breach or default of Assignor occurring prior to the Assignment Date (the " Retained Liabilities ").
