title: Angel Oak Residential Evergreen Trust
text: EX-10.3 8 tm2630475d1_ex10-3.htm EXHIBIT 10.3 Exhibit 10.3 CONTRIBUTION AND ISSUANCE AGREEMENT This Contribution and Issuance Agreement (this “ Agreement ”), effective as of November 19, 2026 (the “ Effective Date ”), is by and among each investor whose name is set forth on Exhibit A (each an “ Assignor ” and collectively the “ Assignors ”), Angel Oak Real Estate Investment Fund II-C LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (“ REIF II-C ”), its managing member, Angel Oak Capital Partners II, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (“ REIF Managing Member ”), Angel Oak Residential Evergreen Trust, a Maryland statutory trust (the “ REIT ”), Angel Oak Residential Evergreen Operating Partnership L.P., a Delaware limited partnership (the “ Operating Partnership ”), AO Residential Evergreen OP GP, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and the general partner of the Operating Partnership (the “ OP General Partner ”), and Angel Oak Capital Advisors, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and manager for each of the REIT, the Operating Partnership and REIF II-C (the “ Manager ”). WHEREAS, the Assignors, collectively, own all “Investor Member Interests” in REIF II-C, other than the Investor Member Interests held by that certain investor member of REIF II-C that is not a party to this Agreement (the “ Exiting Member ”) (the Investor Member Interests held by the Assignors, collectively the “ REIF II-C Member Interests ”), pursuant to that certain limited liability company agreement of REIF II-C (as amended and restated through the date hereof and attached hereto as Exhibit F , the “ REIF II-C Operating Agreement ”) and those certain Subscription Agreements by and between each Assignor, REIF II-C and the REIF Managing Member (together with any assignment agreements or other modifications to such subscription agreements, the “ Subscription Agreements ”); WHEREAS, the REIF Managing Member owns all “Managing Member Interests” in REIF II-C (the “ REIF II-C Managing Interest ”) pursuant to the REIF II-C Operating Agreement; WHEREAS, the Assignors desire to contribute 100% of the REIF II-C Member Interests to the REIT and/or the Operating Partnership in exchange for Series A-I shares in the REIT and/or Series A-I units in the Operating Partnership, as applicable, as set forth on Exhibit A , and the REIT and the Operating Partnership, as applicable, desire to accept the REIF II-C Member Interests, in each case subject to the terms and provisions of this Agreement, the Confidential Private Placement Memorandum of the REIT (as amended, modified, supplemented or restated from time to time, the “ Memorandum ”), the Amended and Restated Declaration of Trust of the REIT (as amended, modified, supplemented or restated from time to time, the “ Declaration of Trust ”), the Bylaws of the REIT (as amended, modified, supplemented or restated from time to time, the “ Bylaws ”, and together with the Memorandum and the Declaration of Trust, the “ REIT Governing Materials ”) attached hereto as Exhibit B and the Limited Partnership Agreement of the Operating Partnership (as amended, modified, supplemented or restated from time to time, the “ Operating Partnership Agreement ”) attached hereto as Exhibit C ; WHEREAS, the REIF Managing Member desires to contribute 100% of the REIF II-C Managing Interest to the REIT in exchange for Series A-I shares in the REIT in the amounts set forth on Exhibit A , and the REIT desires to accept the REIF II-C Managing Interest, in each case subject to the terms and provisions of this Agreement and the REIT Governing Materials; 1 WHEREAS, the REIT desires to contribute 100% of the received REIF II-C Member Interests and REIF II-C Managing Interest to the Operating Partnership in exchange for limited partner interests in the Operating Partnership, and the Operating Partnership desires to accept the REIF II-C Member Interests and REIF II-C Managing Interest, in each case subject to the terms and provisions of this Agreement and the Operating Partnership Agreement; WHEREAS, the board of trustees of the REIT, the Manager and the OP General Partner desire to consent to the contributions and assignments of the REIF II-C Member Interests and REIF II-C Managing Interest contemplated herein; WHEREAS, following such assignments, (i) Assignors will own Series A-I shares in the REIT and/or Series A-I units in the Operating Partnership, as applicable and described on Exhibit A , (ii) the REIF Managing Member will own Series A-I shares in the REIT and will have received the Cash Distribution (as defined below), each as described on Exhibit A , (iii) the REIT will own limited partner interests in the Operating Partnership, and (iv) the Operating Partnership will own the REIF II-C Member Interests and REIF II-C Managing Interest. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements herein made and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, and intending to be legally bound, the parties hereto agree as follows: 1. Contribution and Issuance . (a) REIF II-C Member Interests to REIT. (i) Effective as of the Effective Date, each Assignor identified on Schedule 1 of Exhibit A hereby grants, conveys, assigns, contributes and transfers to the REIT all of such Assignor’s right, title and interest in and to such Assignor’s REIF II-C Member Interests, together with all associated rights, privileges, restrictions and obligations related to the REIF II-C Member Interests; provided, however, that, notwithstanding the foregoing or any other provision herein to the contrary, such Assignor is not assigning, and the REIT is not acquiring or assuming, any Excluded Obligations (as defined below), all of which shall remain obligations of the Assignors. (ii) The REIT hereby accepts the assignment of the REIF II-C Member Interests and expressly assumes any and all obligations and liabilities of such Assignors with respect thereto relating to the REIF II-C Member Interests, other than the Excluded Obligations. (iii) In consideration of the assignment of the REIF II-C Member Interests from such Assignors to the REIT, the REIT hereby issues Series A-I shares in the REIT to each Assignor in the amount set forth on Schedule 1 of Exhibit A subject to the terms and conditions set forth in the REIT Governing Materials, and each such Assignor hereby accepts such Series A-I shares in the REIT. (iv) For purposes of this Agreement, “ Excluded Obligations ” means, with respect to each Assignor and its respective REIF II-C Member Interests, any and all obligations arising out of or resulting from (a) a breach by such Assignor of any covenant, agreement, representation or warranty made by such Assignor in such Assignor’s Subscription Agreement, the REIF II-C Operating Agreement or any other contractual obligation applicable to the REIF II-C Member Interests; (b) any obligation to return or otherwise repay amounts relating to the REIF II-C Member Interests to REIF II-C arising by operation of the “member giveback” obligations pursuant to Section 5.2(b) of the REIF II-C Operating Agreement (the “ Member Giveback ”); or (c) any tax liabilities of such Assignor (or of REIF II-C in respect of such Assignor) relating to the REIF II-C Member Interests and any liabilities for withholding taxes with respect to distributions or allocations to such Assignor, in each case solely to the extent attributable to any taxable period (or portion thereof) ending on or prior to the Effective Date and asserted in writing against such Assignor prior to the expiration of the statute of limitations applicable to the assessment of such tax liabilities. 2 (b) REIF II-C Member Interests to the Operating Partnership. (i) From Assignors. (1) Effective as of the Effective Date, each Assignor identified on Schedule 2 of Exhibit A hereby grants, conveys, assigns, contributes and transfers to the Operating Partnership all of such Assignor’s right, title and interest in and to such Assignor’s REIF II-C Member Interests, together with all associated rights, privileges, restrictions and obligations related to the REIF II-C Member Interests; provided, however, that, notwithstanding the foregoing or any other provision herein to the contrary, such Assignor is not assigning, and the Operating Partnership is not acquiring or assuming, any Excluded Obligations, all of which shall remain obligations of the Assignors. (2) The Operating Partnership hereby accepts the assignment of the REIF II-C Member Interests and expressly assumes any and all obligations and liabilities of such Assignors with respect thereto relating to the REIF II-C Member Interests, other than the Excluded Obligations. (3) In consideration of the assignment of the REIF II-C Member Interests from such Assignors to the Operating Partnership, the Operating Partnership hereby issues Series A-I units in the Operating Partnership to each Assignor in the amount set forth on Schedule 2 of Exhibit A subject to terms and conditions set forth in the Operating Partnership Agreement, and each such Assignor hereby accepts such Series A-I units in the Operating Partnership. (ii) From REIT. (1) Effective as of the Effective Date, the REIT hereby grants, conveys, assigns, contributes and transfers to the Operating Partnership all of the REIT’s right, title and interest in and to the REIF II-C Member Interests received by the REIT in Section 1(a) hereof, together with all associated rights, privileges, restrictions and obligations related to such REIF II-C Member Interests. (2) The Operating Partnership hereby accepts the assignment of such REIF II-C Member Interests and expressly assumes any and all obligations and liabilities of the REIT with respect thereto relating to such REIF II-C Member Interests. (3) In consideration of the assignment of such REIF II-C Member Interests from the REIT to the Operating Partnership, the Operating Partnership hereby issues limited partner interests in the Operating Partnership to the REIT subject to terms and conditions set forth in the Operating Partnership Agreement, and the REIT hereby accepts such limited partner interests in the Operating Partnership. (c) REIF II-C Managing Interest to REIT. (i) Effective as of the Effective Date, the REIF Managing Member hereby grants, conveys, assigns, contributes and transfers to the REIT all of the REIF Managing Member’s right, title and interest in and to the REIF II-C Managing Interest, together with all associated rights, privileges, restrictions and obligations related to the REIF II-C Managing Interest, except for those indemnification obligations of the REIF Managing Member under Section 5(b). 3 (ii) The REIT hereby accepts the assignment of the REIF II-C Managing Interest and expressly assumes any and all obligations and liabilities of the REIF Managing Member with respect thereto relating to the REIF II-C Managing Interest, except for those indemnification obligations of the REIF Managing Member under Section 5(b). (iii) In consideration of the assignment of the REIF II-C Managing Interest from the REIF Managing Member to the REIT, the REIT hereby issues Series A-I shares in the REIT to the REIF Managing Member in the amount set forth on Schedule 3 of Exhibit A subject to terms and conditions set forth in the REIT Governing Materials, and the REIF Managing Member hereby accepts such Series A-I shares in the REIT. In connection with the foregoing and the transactions contemplated hereby, notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the REIF II-C Operating Agreement, contemporaneous with the contributions and issuances hereunder, the REIF Managing Member shall also receive a cash distribution from REIF II-C in the amount set forth on Schedule 3 of Exhibit A reflecting a portion of the carried interest or other incentive allocations to which the REIF Managing Member would have been entitled under the REIF II-C Operating Agreement, determined based on a hypothetical liquidation of REIF II-C as of October 31, 2026 as set forth on Schedule 3 of Exhibit A (the “ Cash Distribution ”). (d) REIF II-C Managing Interest to the Operating Partnership. (i) Effective as of the Effective Date, the REIT hereby grants, conveys, assigns, contributes and transfers to the Operating Partnership all of the REIT’s right, title and interest in and to the REIF II-C Managing Interest received by the REIT in Section 1(c) hereof, together with all associated rights, privileges, restrictions and obligations related to the REIF II-C Managing Interest. (ii) The Operating Partnership hereby accepts the assignment of the REIF II-C Managing Interest and expressly assumes any and all obligations and liabilities of the REIT with respect thereto relating to the REIF II-C Managing Interest. (iii) In consideration of the assignment of the REIF II-C Managing Interest from the REIT to the Operating Partnership, the Operating Partnership hereby issues limited partner interests in the Operating Partnership to the REIT on the terms and conditions set forth in the Operating Partnership Agreement, and the REIT hereby accepts such limited partner interests in the Operating Partnership in accordance with the Operating Partnership Agreement. 2. Continuing Effect . Each Assignor hereby represents and warrants to the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner and the Operating Partnership, as applicable, that the information related to such Assignor’s name, contact information, wiring information and other identifying information included in such Assignor’s Subscription Agreement, to the extent applicable, remains true, correct and complete as of the date hereof. 3. Consent; Effect of Transactions . The REIT, the Manager and the OP General Partner hereby consent to the assignments and assumptions contemplated hereunder and the issuance of the Series A-I shares and Series A-I units as contemplated by this Agreement. The board of trustees of the REIT and the Manager hereby confirm that all requirements for the issuance of the Series A-I shares of the REIT and the payment of the Cash Distribution have been duly satisfied. The OP General Partner hereby confirms that all requirements for the issuance of the Series A-I units of the Operating Partnership have been duly satisfied. 4 4. Representations and Warranties . (a) Each Assignor hereby represents and warrants to the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner and the Operating Partnership, as of the Effective Date, as follows: (i) Immediately prior to the assignments contemplated herein, the REIF II-C Member Interests are owned either directly by the Assignor or beneficially through a custodial account maintained by a custodian or nominee for the benefit of the Assignor pursuant to the REIF II-C Operating Agreement, applicable federal and state securities laws and the terms of the Assignor’s Subscription Agreement. (ii) The Assignor has the right, power and authority to perform its obligations hereunder. The execution, delivery and performance by the Assignor (or its designated representative) of this Agreement have been duly authorized by all necessary action on the part of the Assignor. This Agreement has been duly and validly executed and delivered by the Assignor (or its designated representative) and constitutes the legal, valid and binding obligation of the Assignor, enforceable against the Assignor in accordance with its terms, subject to (A) laws of general application relating to bankruptcy, insolvency and the relief of debtors, and (B) rules of law governing specific performance, injunctive relief and other equitable remedies. (iii) Subject to obtaining the consent of the Manager, the REIF Managing Member, the REIT, the OP General Partner and the Operating Partnership to the transactions contemplated herein, the execution and delivery by the Assignor (or its designated representative) of this Agreement and the consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby by the Assignor (A) are not prohibited by, and will not violate or conflict with, any provision of the organizational documents of the Assignor, and (B) are not prohibited by, and will not violate, any law, rule, regulation or other legal requirement applicable to the Assignor. (iv) No filing with, notice to or consent from any governmental authority is required in connection with (A) the execution, delivery or performance of this Agreement by the Assignor (or its designated representative) or (B) the consummation by the Assignor of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement. (v) Each Assignor owns its REIF II-C Member Interests free and clear of all liens, pledges, security interests, charges, claims, options and other encumbrances (collectively, “ Liens ”) other than (A) restrictions on transfer arising under the REIF II-C Operating Agreement or applicable federal and state securities laws or (B) Liens which shall be extinguished upon consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby, has not sold, assigned, pledged or otherwise transferred any portion thereof, and, upon issuance of the Series A-I shares in the REIT and/or Series A-I units in the Operating Partnership, as applicable, the REIT and the Operating Partnership, as applicable will acquire good and valid title to such REIF II-C Member Interests, free and clear of all Liens other than restrictions on transfer arising under applicable federal and state securities laws. (vi) Each Assignor acquiring Series A-I shares of the REIT, as identified on Schedule 1 of Exhibit A , hereby agrees to become a party to and be bound by all of the provisions of the REIT Governing Materials, as applicable. 5 (vii) Each Assignor acquiring Series A-I shares of the REIT, as identified on Schedule 1 of Exhibit A , hereby makes the representations, warranties and covenants required of a “Subscriber” pursuant to the subscription agreement of the REIT attached hereto as Exhibit D (the “ REIT Subscription Agreement ”) and such representations, warranties and covenants, to the extent applicable, are incorporated herein by reference and deemed to be modified to reflect such Assignor acquiring Series A-I shares pursuant to this Agreement and not a subscription for new shares. (viii) Each Assignor acquiring Series A-I units of the Operating Partnership, as identified on Schedule 2 of Exhibit A , hereby agrees to become a party to and be bound by all of the provisions of the Operating Partnership Agreement, as applicable. (ix) Each Assignor acquiring Series A-I units of the Operating Partnership, as identified on Schedule 2 of Exhibit A , hereby makes the representations, warranties and covenants required of a “Subscriber” pursuant to the subscription agreement of the Operating Partnership attached hereto as Exhibit E (the “ Operating Partnership Subscription Agreement ”) and such representations, warranties and covenants, to the extent applicable, are incorporated herein by reference and deemed to be modified to reflect such Assignor acquiring Series A-I units pursuant to this Agreement and not a subscription for new units. (x) Each Assignor acknowledges and agrees that, in connection with and substantially concurrently with the transactions contemplated by this Agreement, the Exiting Member is not contributing its Investor Member Interests pursuant to this Agreement and is instead disposing of its Investor Member Interests to the REIT pursuant to a separate Purchase, Sale, Assignment and Assumption Agreement (the “ Exiting Member PSA ”), and that the contributions, issuances and other transactions contemplated by this Agreement are not affected thereby. Each Assignor has had the opportunity to ask questions regarding the terms of the Exiting Member PSA, consents thereto, and agrees that it shall not have any claim against REIF II-C, the REIF Managing Member, the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner, the Operating Partnership or any of their respective affiliates arising out of or relating to the Exiting Member PSA or the consideration received by any person thereunder, including any difference between the form, amount or value of such consideration and the Series A-I shares in the REIT and/or Series A-I units in the Operating Partnership issued to the Assignors hereunder. (xi) Each Assignor has had the opportunity to ask questions regarding the terms of this Agreement and all transactions contemplated hereby including the transactions relating to the REIF Managing Member and its carried interest in REIF II-C and consents thereto, and agrees that it shall not have any claim against REIF II-C, the REIF Managing Member, the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner, the Operating Partnership or any of their respective affiliates arising out of or relating to the consideration received by the REIF Managing Member hereunder, unless such person acted with fraud, willful misconduct or gross negligence. (b) The REIF Managing Member hereby represents and warrants to the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner and the Operating Partnership, as of the Effective Date, as follows: (i) Immediately prior to the assignments contemplated herein, the REIF II-C Managing Interest is owned of record and entirely by the REIF Managing Member pursuant to the REIF II-C Operating Agreement. (ii) The REIF Managing Member has the right, power and authority to perform its obligations hereunder. The execution, delivery and performance by the REIF Managing Member of this Agreement have been duly authorized by all necessary action on the part of the REIF Managing Member. This Agreement has been duly and validly executed and delivered by the REIF Managing Member and constitutes the legal, valid and binding obligation of the REIF Managing Member, enforceable against the REIF Managing Member in accordance with its terms, subject to (A) laws of general application relating to bankruptcy, insolvency and the relief of debtors, and (B) rules of law governing specific performance, injunctive relief and other equitable remedies. 6 (iii) Subject to obtaining the consent of the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner and the Operating Partnership to the transactions contemplated herein, the execution and delivery by the REIF Managing Member of this Agreement and the consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby by the REIF Managing Member (A) are not prohibited by, and will not violate or conflict with, any provision of the organizational documents of the REIF Managing Member, and (B) are not prohibited by, and will not violate, any law, rule, regulation or other legal requirement applicable to the REIF Managing Member. (iv) The REIF Managing Member hereby makes the representations, warranties and covenants required of a “Subscriber” pursuant to the REIT Subscription Agreement and such representations, warranties and covenants, to the extent applicable, are incorporated herein by reference and deemed to be modified to reflect the REIF Managing Member acquiring Series A-I shares pursuant to this Agreement and not a subscription for new shares. (v) No filing with, notice to or consent from any governmental authority is required in connection with (A) the execution, delivery or performance of this Agreement by the REIF Managing Member or (B) the consummation by the REIF Managing Member of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement. (c) The REIF Managing Member further represents and warrants, solely in its capacity as managing member of REIF II-C and on behalf of REIF II-C, to the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner, the Operating Partnership and the Assignors, as of the Effective Date, as follows: (i) REIF II-C is a limited liability company duly formed, validly existing and in good standing under the laws of the State of Delaware and has all requisite limited liability company power and authority to own its assets and to carry on its business as currently conducted in all material respects. (ii) The REIF II-C Member Interests and the REIF II-C Managing Interest have been duly authorized and validly issued in accordance with the REIF II-C Operating Agreement and together constitute all of the issued and outstanding equity interests in REIF II-C. Except as set forth in the REIF II-C Operating Agreement or the Subscription Agreements, there are no outstanding options, warrants, rights, convertible or exchangeable securities, subscriptions, commitments or other agreements obligating REIF II-C to issue, sell, repurchase or redeem any equity interests in REIF II-C. (iii) REIF II-C has good and valid title to each of the Investments (as defined in the REIF II-C Operating Agreement) held by REIF II-C, free and clear of all Liens other than (A) Liens for taxes not yet due and payable or being contested in good faith, (B) restrictions on transfer arising under applicable federal and state securities laws, (C) Liens arising under the organizational or governing documents of the applicable issuer or obligor of any Investment of REIF II-C or under the REIF II-C Operating Agreement, (D) Liens securing any indebtedness or credit facility of REIF II-C or any issuer or obligor of an Investment, in each case disclosed to the Manager, and (E) other Liens that would not, individually or in the aggregate, reasonably be expected to materially impair the value of the Investments, taken as a whole. 7 (iv) There is no action, suit, claim, proceeding, arbitration or investigation pending or, to the knowledge of the REIF Managing Member, threatened in writing against REIF II-C, any REIF II-C Covered Person (as defined in Section 5(f)) in its capacity as such or, to the knowledge of the REIF Managing Member, any of the Investments held by REIF II-C that (A) would reasonably be expected to be material to REIF II-C, or (B) challenges or seeks to prevent, enjoin or materially delay the transactions contemplated by this Agreement, and, to the knowledge of the REIF Managing Member, no facts or circumstances exist that would reasonably be expected to give rise to any such action, suit, claim, proceeding, arbitration or investigation or would otherwise result in any obligation of an Assignor to make a Member Giveback. Neither REIF II-C nor, to the knowledge of the REIF Managing Member, any of the Investments held by REIF II-C is subject to any outstanding order, judgment, injunction or decree of any governmental authority that is material to REIF II-C. (v) To the knowledge of the REIF Managing Member, REIF II-C has been operated and managed in all material respects in accordance with applicable law and the REIF II-C Operating Agreement, except for such failures as would not, individually or in the aggregate, reasonably be expected to be material to REIF II-C. (d) The REIT represents and warrants to the Operating Partnership, the OP General Partner, the REIF Managing Member and the Assignors identified on Exhibit A , as of the Effective Date, as follows: (i) The REIT has the right, power and authority to perform its obligations hereunder. The execution, delivery and performance by the REIT of this Agreement have been duly authorized by all necessary action on the part of the REIT. This Agreement has been duly and validly executed and delivered by the REIT and constitutes the legal, valid and binding obligation of the REIT, enforceable against the REIT in accordance with its terms, subject to (A) laws of general application relating to bankruptcy, insolvency and the relief of debtors, and (B) rules of law governing specific performance, injunctive relief and other equitable remedies. (ii) Subject to obtaining the consent of the OP General Partner and the Operating Partnership to the transactions contemplated herein, the execution and delivery by the REIT of this Agreement and the consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby by the REIT (A) are not prohibited by, and will not violate or conflict with, any provision of the organizational documents of the REIT or the Operating Partnership, and (B) are not prohibited by, and will not violate, any law, rule, regulation or other legal requirement applicable to the REIT. (iii) No filing with, notice to or consent from any governmental authority is required in connection with (A) the execution, delivery or performance of this Agreement by the REIT or (B) the consummation by the REIT of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement. (e) The Operating Partnership represents and warrants to the REIT, the Manager and the Assignors identified on Exhibit A , as of the Effective Date, as follows: (i) The Operating Partnership has the right, power and authority to perform its obligations hereunder. The execution, delivery and performance by the Operating Partnership of this Agreement have been duly authorized by all necessary action on the part of the Operating Partnership. This Agreement has been duly and validly executed and delivered by the Operating Partnership and constitutes the legal, valid and binding obligation of the Operating Partnership, enforceable against the Operating Partnership in accordance with its terms, subject to (A) laws of general application relating to bankruptcy, insolvency and the relief of debtors, and (B) rules of law governing specific performance, injunctive relief and other equitable remedies. 8 (ii) Subject to obtaining the consent of the REIT and the Manager to the transactions contemplated herein, the execution and delivery by the Operating Partnership of this Agreement and the consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby by the Operating Partnership (A) are not prohibited by, and will not violate or conflict with, any provision of the organizational documents of the Operating Partnership or the REIT, and (B) are not prohibited by, and will not violate, any law, rule, regulation or other legal requirement applicable to the Operating Partnership. (iii) No filing with, notice to or consent from any governmental authority is required in connection with (A) the execution, delivery or performance of this Agreement by the Operating Partnership or (B) the consummation by the Operating Partnership of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement. (f) Each Assignor has concluded its own independent evaluation and made its own analysis as it has deemed necessary, prudent or advisable in order for it to make its own determination and decision to contribute the REIF II-C Member Interests to the REIT and the Operating Partnership, as applicable, and to acquire Series A-I shares and Series A-I units, as applicable, as contemplated herein, and to enter into this Agreement and consummate the transactions contemplated hereby. Each Assignor is entering into this Agreement and the transactions contemplated hereby relying entirely upon such independent evaluation and analysis and without reliance upon any representations or warranties of any kind or nature (except as set forth herein or in the REIT Governing Materials) or other information (in each case, whether oral or written) from the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner, the Operating Partnership, any of their affiliates or any of their partners, employees, agents, directors, officers, members, managers, representatives or advisors. (g) The REIF Managing Member has concluded its own independent evaluation and made its own analysis as it has deemed necessary, prudent or advisable in order for it to make its own determination and decision to contribute the REIF II-C Managing Interest to the REIT and to acquire Series A-I shares, as contemplated herein, and to enter into this Agreement and consummate the transactions contemplated hereby. The REIF Managing Member is entering into this Agreement and the transactions contemplated hereby relying entirely upon such independent evaluation and analysis and without reliance upon any representations or warranties of any kind or nature (except as set forth herein or in the REIT Governing Materials) or other information (in each case, whether oral or written) from the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner, the Operating Partnership, any of their affiliates or any of their partners, employees, agents, directors, officers, members, managers, representatives or advisors. (h) Each Assignor hereby releases and discharges the REIF Managing Member, REIF II-C, the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner, the Operating Partnership and each of their affiliates, from any and all claims, demands, suits, liabilities, obligations, judgments, orders, debts, liens and causes of action of every kind and nature, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, concealed or hidden, vested or contingent, in law or equity, existing by statute, common law, contract or otherwise, which have existed, may exist in the future or do exist now, arising from or relating in any way to: (i) the assignments and assumptions contemplated in this Agreement; (ii) the consents of the Manager and the OP General Partner to the assignments and assumptions contemplated in this Agreement; (iii) any valuation and/or other data or information provided in good faith by the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner, the Operating Partnership, any of their affiliates or any of their partners, employees, agents, directors, officers, members, managers, representatives or advisors (other than data or information arising out of gross negligence, willful malfeasance or fraud of the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner, the Operating Partnership, any of their affiliates or any of their partners, employees, agents, directors, officers, members, managers, representatives or advisors); and (iv) any involvement by the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner or the Operating Partnership in the assignments and assumptions contemplated in this Agreement, including, to the extent applicable, any facilitating or assisting with such transactions. For the avoidance of doubt, in no event shall the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner, the Operating Partnership, any of their affiliates or any of their partners, employees, agents, directors, officers, members, managers, representatives or advisors be released or discharged from their obligations under this Agreement or their duties under the REIF II-C Operating Agreement or at law owed to the Assignors prior to the Effective Date. 9 5. Indemnity . (a) Assignors . Each Assignor, on a several and not joint basis, agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner, the Operating Partnership, any of their affiliates or any of their partners, employees, agents, directors, officers, members, managers, representatives or advisors (collectively, the “ REIT Indemnified Parties ”) against any losses, claims, damages, liabilities or expenses to which any REIT Indemnified Party may become subject arising out of or based upon any false representation or warranty made by, or breach or failure to comply with any covenant or agreement of, such Assignor herein, subject to the terms and limitations set forth in this Section 5. (b) REIF Managing Member . The REIF Managing Member agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the REIT Indemnified Parties against any losses, claims, damages, liabilities or expenses to which any REIT Indemnified Party may become subject arising out of or based upon any false representation or warranty made by the REIF Managing Member herein or any breach or failure to comply with any covenant or agreement of the REIF Managing Member herein, subject to the terms and limitations set forth in this Section 5. (c) Survival . The representations and warranties of the Assignors and the REIF Managing Member set forth herein, and the right of any REIT Indemnified Party to make a claim under this Section 5 with respect thereto, shall survive the Effective Date until the date that is twelve (12) months following the Effective Date; provided, however, that the representations and warranties set forth in Sections 4(a) and 4(b) hereof, and the right of any REIT Indemnified Party to make a claim under this Section 5 with respect thereto shall survive the Effective Date until the date that is thirty-six (36) months following the Effective Date. Notwithstanding the foregoing, any claim asserted in good faith and with reasonable specificity in a written notice delivered to the applicable indemnifying party prior to the expiration of the applicable survival period shall survive until such claim is finally resolved. The parties specifically intend that the survival period set forth in this Section 5(c) shall replace any statute of limitations that would otherwise be applicable. (d) Limitations . Notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, the indemnification obligations of (A) each Assignor under Section 5(a) with respect to the representations and warranties of such Assignor set forth herein and (B) the REIF Managing Member under Section 5(b) with respect to the representations and warranties set forth in Section 4(c) hereof shall be subject to the following limitations: (i) Cap . The aggregate liability of (A) each Assignor for losses arising out of any inaccuracy in or breach of any representation or warranty of such Assignor set forth in Section 4(a) shall not exceed an amount equal to ten percent (10%) of the aggregate value of the consideration being issued to such Assignor pursuant to Section 1 of this Agreement, and (B) the REIF Managing Member for losses arising out of any inaccuracy in or breach of any representation or warranty of the REIF Managing Member set forth in Section 4(c) shall not exceed an amount equal to ten percent (10%) of the aggregate value of the consideration being issued to the Assignors and the REIF Managing Member pursuant to Section 1 of this Agreement. (ii) Exceptions . None of the limitations set forth in this Section 5(d) shall apply to losses arising out of fraud, willful misconduct, gross negligence, bad faith, any material violation of applicable law or material breach of the REIF II-C Operating Agreement by the applicable indemnifying party. 10 (iii) Calculation of Losses . The amount of any losses shall be calculated net of any insurance proceeds and any indemnity, contribution or similar payments actually recovered by the REIT Indemnified Parties from third parties in respect of such losses, and no REIT Indemnified Party shall be entitled to recover more than once in respect of the same loss. (e) Exclusive Remedy . From and after the Effective Date, except in the case of fraud and except for claims for specific performance, injunctive relief or other equitable remedies, the indemnification provided in this Section 5 shall be the sole and exclusive remedy of the REIT Indemnified Parties with respect to any inaccuracy in or breach by an Assignor or the REIF Managing Member (as applicable) of any representation, warranty, covenant or agreement contained in this Agreement. In no event shall the REIF Managing Member or any Assignor be liable for punitive or exemplary damages, except to the extent actually paid to a third party. Notwithstanding the foregoing, this Section 5(e) shall not apply to, nor limit any rights or remedies of, any Assignor. (f) Continued Indemnification of the REIF Managing Member . Notwithstanding the transactions contemplated by Section 1 or any subsequent dissolution, liquidation, merger or other reorganization of REIF II-C, the REIF Managing Member, its affiliates and each other person entitled to indemnification, exculpation or advancement of expenses under the REIF II-C Operating Agreement (each, a “ REIF II-C Covered Person ”) shall continue to be entitled to indemnification, exculpation and advancement of expenses from REIF II-C on the same terms, subject to the same conditions and limitations, and to the same extent as provided in the REIF II-C Operating Agreement as in effect immediately prior to the Effective Date, as if REIF II-C continued to exist and the REIF II-C Operating Agreement as in effect immediately prior to the Effective Date continued in effect thereafter, with respect to any acts or omissions occurring, or matters arising out of facts or circumstances existing, at or prior to the Effective Date (including the approval and consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby and the representations and warranties made herein); provided, however, that the assets available to REIF II-C to indemnify the REIF Managing Member pursuant to the foregoing shall be limited to the proceeds of any Member Giveback, which, for the avoidance of doubt, shall be Excluded Obligations retained by the Assignors. In furtherance of the foregoing, each Assignor hereby acknowledges and agrees that each Assignor is retaining its Member Giveback obligations as in effect immediately prior to the Effective Date under the REIF II-C Operating Agreement, as if REIF II-C continued to exist and the REIF II-C Operating Agreement as in effect immediately prior to the Effective Date continued in effect thereafter. (g) Third-Party Claims . Any REIT Indemnified Party seeking indemnification hereunder in respect of a claim asserted by a third party shall give prompt written notice thereof to the indemnifying party (provided that, failure to give such notice shall not relieve the indemnifying party of its obligations except to the extent it is prejudiced thereby). The indemnifying party shall be entitled to assume and control the defense of such claim with counsel reasonably acceptable to the REIT Indemnified Party, and the REIT Indemnified Party shall reasonably cooperate in such defense. No REIT Indemnified Party shall settle or compromise any such claim without the prior written consent of the indemnifying party (not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed), and the indemnifying party shall not settle any such claim without the consent of the REIT Indemnified Party unless such settlement involves only the payment of money damages that are fully indemnified hereunder and includes a full release of the REIT Indemnified Party. 11 6. Tax Matters. (a) For all applicable income tax purposes, the transactions contemplated by Section 1 of this Agreement will be treated by the parties hereto as a sale of partnership interests in REIF II-C to the REIT and the Operating Partnership, as applicable, pursuant to sections 351(e) and 721(b) of the Internal Revenue Code, as applicable (the “ Agreed Tax Treatment ”). None of the parties to this Agreement shall take any position for income tax purposes (whether in audits, tax returns or otherwise) which is inconsistent with the Agreed Tax Treatment unless required to do so by a “determination” within the meaning of Section 1313(a) of the Internal Revenue Code. (b) REIF II-C, through the REIF Managing Member, shall, as of the Effective Date, complete the certification attached as Exhibit G hereto in order to prevent any withholding obligation on the part of the REIT or the Operating Partnership in connection with the Agreed Tax Treatment. 7. Expenses . The REIT agrees to pay and/or reimburse, or cause to be paid and/or reimbursed, the Manager for all reasonable and documented expenses, including reasonable attorney’s fees and expenses, incurred by the Manager in connection with the preparation and negotiation of this Agreement. 8. Further Assurances . Each of the parties hereto shall execute and cause to be delivered to the other party hereto such instruments and other documents, and shall take such other actions, as such other party may reasonably request for the purpose of carrying out or evidencing any of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement. 9. Amendments . This Agreement may not be amended, modified, altered or supplemented other than by means of a written instrument duly executed and delivered on behalf of all of the parties hereto. 10. Governing Law . This Agreement and all rights and obligations arising hereunder shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the laws of the State of Delaware, without giving effect to the provisions, policies or principles thereof relating to choice or conflicts of law. TO THE EXTENT NOT PROHIBITED BY APPLICABLE LAW WHICH CANNOT BE WAIVED, EACH PARTY HERETO HEREBY WAIVES AND COVENANTS THAT IT SHALL NOT ASSERT (WHETHER AS PLAINTIFF, DEFENDANT OR OTHERWISE) ANY RIGHT TO TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY FORUM IN RESPECT OF ANY ISSUE OR ACTION, CLAIM, CAUSE OF ACTION OR SUIT (IN CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE), INQUIRY, PROCEEDING OR INVESTIGATION ARISING OUT OF OR BASED UPON THIS AGREEMENT OR THE SUBJECT MATTER HEREOF OR IN ANY WAY CONNECTED WITH OR RELATED OR INCIDENTAL TO THE TRANSACTIONS CONTEMPLATED HEREBY, IN EACH CASE WHETHER NOW EXISTING OR HEREAFTER ARISING. EACH PARTY HERETO ACKNOWLEDGES THAT IT HAS BEEN INFORMED BY THE OTHER PARTIES HERETO THAT THIS SECTION 10 CONSTITUTES A MATERIAL INDUCEMENT UPON WHICH THEY ARE RELYING AND SHALL RELY IN ENTERING INTO THIS AGREEMENT. ANY PARTY HERETO MAY FILE AN ORIGINAL COUNTERPART OR A COPY OF THIS SECTION 10 WITH ANY COURT AS WRITTEN EVIDENCE OF THE CONSENT OF EACH SUCH PARTY TO THE WAIVER OF ITS RIGHT TO TRIAL BY JURY. 11. Counterparts and Electronic Delivery . This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which, taken together, shall constitute one and the same instrument. Delivery of an executed signature page of this Agreement by electronic mail in portable document format (PDF) will be effective as delivery of a manually executed signature page of this Agreement. 12. Severability . If any provisions of this Agreement are determined to be invalid, illegal or unenforceable by any governmental entity, the remaining provisions of this Agreement, to the extent permitted by law, shall remain in full force and effect. 12 13. Entire Agreement . Except as otherwise expressly provided herein, this Agreement constitutes the sole and entire agreement of the parties to this Agreement with respect to the subject matter contained herein, and supersedes all prior and contemporaneous understandings, representations and warranties and agreements, both written and oral, with respect to such subject matter. 14. No Waiver. No waiver by any party of any of the provisions of this Agreement shall be effective unless explicitly set forth in writing and signed by the party so waiving. Except as otherwise set forth in this Agreement, no failure to exercise, or delay in exercising, any right, remedy, power, or privilege arising from this Agreement shall operate or be construed as a waiver thereof; nor shall any single or partial exercise of any right, remedy, power, or privilege hereunder preclude any other or further exercise thereof or the exercise of any other right, remedy, power, or privilege. 15. Interpretation; Headings . Every term and provision of this Agreement shall be construed simply according to its fair meaning and not strictly for or against any party. All headings herein are inserted only for convenience and ease of reference and are not to be considered in the construction or interpretation of any provision of this Agreement.
