title: Angel Oak Residential Evergreen Trust
text: EX-10.4 9 tm2630475d1_ex10-4.htm EXHIBIT 10.4 Exhibit 10.4 CONTRIBUTION AND ISSUANCE AGREEMENT This Contribution and Issuance Agreement (this “ Agreement ”), effective as of November 19, 2026 (the “ Effective Date ”), is by and among each investor whose name is set forth on Exhibit A (each an “ Assignor ” and collectively the “ Assignors ”), Angel Oak Real Estate Investment Fund III-C LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (“ REIF III-C ”), its managing member, Angel Oak Capital Partners II, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (“ REIF Managing Member ”), Angel Oak Residential Evergreen Trust, a Maryland statutory trust (the “ REIT ”), Angel Oak Residential Evergreen Operating Partnership L.P., a Delaware limited partnership (the “ Operating Partnership ”), AO Residential Evergreen OP GP, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and the general partner of the Operating Partnership (the “ OP General Partner ”), and Angel Oak Capital Advisors, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and manager for each of the REIT, the Operating Partnership and REIF III-C (the “ Manager ”). WHEREAS, the Assignors, collectively, own all “Investor Member Interests” in REIF III-C, other than the Investor Member Interests held by that certain investor member of REIF III-C that is not a party to this Agreement (the “ Exiting Member ”) (the Investor Member Interests held by the Assignors, collectively the “ REIF III-C Member Interests ”), pursuant to that certain limited liability company agreement of REIF III-C (as amended and restated through the date hereof and attached hereto as Exhibit F , the “ REIF III-C Operating Agreement ”) and those certain Subscription Agreements by and between each Assignor, REIF III-C and the REIF Managing Member (together with any assignment agreements or other modifications to such subscription agreements, the “ Subscription Agreements ”); WHEREAS, the REIF Managing Member owns all “Managing Member Interests” in REIF III-C (the “ REIF III-C Managing Interest ”) pursuant to the REIF III-C Operating Agreement; WHEREAS, the Assignors desire to contribute 100% of the REIF III-C Member Interests to the REIT and/or the Operating Partnership in exchange for Series A-II shares in the REIT and/or Series A-II units in the Operating Partnership, as applicable, as set forth on Exhibit A , and the REIT and the Operating Partnership, as applicable, desire to accept the REIF III-C Member Interests, in each case subject to the terms and provisions of this Agreement, the Confidential Private Placement Memorandum of the REIT (as amended, modified, supplemented or restated from time to time, the “ Memorandum ”), the Amended and Restated Declaration of Trust of the REIT (as amended, modified, supplemented or restated from time to time, the “ Declaration of Trust ”), the Bylaws of the REIT (as amended, modified, supplemented or restated from time to time, the “ Bylaws ”, and together with the Memorandum and the Declaration of Trust, the “ REIT Governing Materials ”) attached hereto as Exhibit B and the Limited Partnership Agreement of the Operating Partnership (as amended, modified, supplemented or restated from time to time, the “ Operating Partnership Agreement ”) attached hereto as Exhibit C ; WHEREAS, the REIF Managing Member desires to contribute 100% of the REIF III-C Managing Interest to the REIT in exchange for release of its obligations as managing member of REIF III-C, except as provided herein, and the REIT desires to accept the REIF III-C Managing Interest under such terms, in each case subject to the terms and provisions of this Agreement and the REIT Governing Materials; 1 WHEREAS, the REIT desires to contribute 100% of the received REIF III-C Member Interests and REIF III-C Managing Interest to the Operating Partnership in exchange for limited partner interests in the Operating Partnership, and the Operating Partnership desires to accept the REIF III-C Member Interests and REIF III-C Managing Interest, in each case subject to the terms and provisions of this Agreement and the Operating Partnership Agreement; WHEREAS, the board of trustees of the REIT, the Manager and the OP General Partner desire to consent to the contributions and assignments of the REIF III-C Member Interests and REIF III-C Managing Interest contemplated herein; WHEREAS, following such assignments, (i) Assignors will own Series A-II shares in the REIT and/or Series A-II units in the Operating Partnership, as applicable and described on Exhibit A , (ii) the REIT will own limited partner interests in the Operating Partnership, and (iii) the Operating Partnership will own the REIF III-C Member Interests and REIF III-C Managing Interest; WHEREAS, in connection with this Agreement, the Manager has provided that certain Letter Agreement for the benefit of the Assignors (as executed in connection with this Agreement, the “ Letter Agreement ”) attached hereto as Exhibit H . NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements herein made and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, and intending to be legally bound, the parties hereto agree as follows: 1. Contribution and Issuance . (a) REIF III-C Member Interests to REIT. (i) Effective as of the Effective Date, each Assignor identified on Schedule 1 of Exhibit A hereby grants, conveys, assigns, contributes and transfers to the REIT all of such Assignor’s right, title and interest in and to such Assignor’s REIF III-C Member Interests, together with all associated rights, privileges, restrictions and obligations related to the REIF III-C Member Interests; provided, however, that, notwithstanding the foregoing or any other provision herein to the contrary, such Assignor is not assigning, and the REIT is not acquiring or assuming, any Excluded Obligations (as defined below), all of which shall remain obligations of the Assignors. (ii) The REIT hereby accepts the assignment of the REIF III-C Member Interests and expressly assumes any and all obligations and liabilities of such Assignors with respect thereto relating to the REIF III-C Member Interests, other than the Excluded Obligations. (iii) In consideration of the assignment of the REIF III-C Member Interests from such Assignors to the REIT, the REIT hereby issues Series A-II shares in the REIT to each Assignor in the amount set forth on Schedule 1 of Exhibit A subject to the terms and conditions set forth in the REIT Governing Materials, and each such Assignor hereby accepts such Series A-II shares in the REIT. 2 (iv) For purposes of this Agreement, “ Excluded Obligations ” means, with respect to each Assignor and its respective REIF III-C Member Interests, any and all obligations arising out of or resulting from (a) a breach by such Assignor of any covenant, agreement, representation or warranty made by such Assignor in such Assignor’s Subscription Agreement, the REIF III-C Operating Agreement or any other contractual obligation applicable to the REIF III-C Member Interests; (b) any obligation to return or otherwise repay amounts relating to the REIF III-C Member Interests to REIF III-C arising by operation of the “member giveback” obligations pursuant to Section 5.2(b) of the REIF III-C Operating Agreement (the “ Member Giveback ”); or (c) any tax liabilities of such Assignor (or of REIF III-C in respect of such Assignor) relating to the REIF III-C Member Interests and any liabilities for withholding taxes with respect to distributions or allocations to such Assignor, in each case solely to the extent attributable to any taxable period (or portion thereof) ending on or prior to the Effective Date and asserted in writing against such Assignor prior to the expiration of the statute of limitations applicable to the assessment of such tax liabilities. (b) REIF III-C Member Interests to the Operating Partnership. (i) From Assignors. (1) Effective as of the Effective Date, each Assignor identified on Schedule 2 of Exhibit A hereby grants, conveys, assigns, contributes and transfers to the Operating Partnership all of such Assignor’s right, title and interest in and to such Assignor’s REIF III-C Member Interests, together with all associated rights, privileges, restrictions and obligations related to the REIF III-C Member Interests; provided, however, that, notwithstanding the foregoing or any other provision herein to the contrary, such Assignor is not assigning, and the Operating Partnership is not acquiring or assuming, any Excluded Obligations, all of which shall remain obligations of the Assignors. (2) The Operating Partnership hereby accepts the assignment of the REIF III-C Member Interests and expressly assumes any and all obligations and liabilities of such Assignors with respect thereto relating to the REIF III-C Member Interests, other than the Excluded Obligations. (3) In consideration of the assignment of the REIF III-C Member Interests from such Assignors to the Operating Partnership, the Operating Partnership hereby issues Series A-II units in the Operating Partnership to each Assignor in the amount set forth on Schedule 2 of Exhibit A subject to terms and conditions set forth in the Operating Partnership Agreement, and each such Assignor hereby accepts such Series A-II units in the Operating Partnership. (ii) From REIT. (1) Effective as of the Effective Date, the REIT hereby grants, conveys, assigns, contributes and transfers to the Operating Partnership all of the REIT’s right, title and interest in and to the REIF III-C Member Interests received by the REIT in Section 1(a) hereof, together with all associated rights, privileges, restrictions and obligations related to such REIF III-C Member Interests. (2) The Operating Partnership hereby accepts the assignment of such REIF III-C Member Interests and expressly assumes any and all obligations and liabilities of the REIT with respect thereto relating to such REIF III-C Member Interests. (3) In consideration of the assignment of such REIF III-C Member Interests from the REIT to the Operating Partnership, the Operating Partnership hereby issues limited partner interests in the Operating Partnership to the REIT subject to terms and conditions set forth in the Operating Partnership Agreement, and the REIT hereby accepts such limited partner interests in the Operating Partnership. 3 (c) REIF III-C Managing Interest to REIT. (i) Effective as of the Effective Date, the REIF Managing Member hereby grants, conveys, assigns, contributes and transfers to the REIT all of the REIF Managing Member’s right, title and interest in and to the REIF III-C Managing Interest, together with all associated rights, privileges, restrictions and obligations related to the REIF III-C Managing Interest except for those indemnification obligations of the REIF Managing Member under Section 5(b). (ii) The REIT hereby accepts the assignment of the REIF III-C Managing Interest and expressly assumes any and all obligations and liabilities of the REIF Managing Member with respect thereto relating to the REIF III-C Managing Interest, except for those indemnification obligations of the REIF Managing Member under Section 5(b). (iii) In consideration of the assignment of the REIF III-C Managing Interest from the REIF Managing Member to the REIT, the REIT hereby releases the REIF Managing Member of its obligations with respect to the REIF III-C Managing Interest, except for those indemnification obligations of the REIF Managing Member under Section 5(b). (d) REIF III-C Managing Interest to the Operating Partnership. (i) Effective as of the Effective Date, the REIT hereby grants, conveys, assigns, contributes and transfers to the Operating Partnership all of the REIT’s right, title and interest in and to the REIF III-C Managing Interest received by the REIT in Section 1(c) hereof, together with all associated rights, privileges, restrictions and obligations related to the REIF III-C Managing Interest. (ii) The Operating Partnership hereby accepts the assignment of the REIF III-C Managing Interest and expressly assumes any and all obligations and liabilities of the REIT with respect thereto relating to the REIF III-C Managing Interest. (iii) In consideration of the assignment of the REIF III-C Managing Interest from the REIT to the Operating Partnership, the Operating Partnership hereby issues limited partner interests in the Operating Partnership to the REIT on the terms and conditions set forth in the Operating Partnership Agreement, and the REIT hereby accepts such limited partner interests in the Operating Partnership in accordance with the Operating Partnership Agreement. 2. Continuing Effect . Each Assignor hereby represents and warrants to the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner and the Operating Partnership, as applicable, that the information related to such Assignor’s name, contact information, wiring information and other identifying information included in such Assignor’s Subscription Agreement, to the extent applicable, remains true, correct and complete as of the date hereof. 3. Consent; Effect of Transactions . The REIT, the Manager and the OP General Partner hereby consent to the assignments and assumptions contemplated hereunder and the issuance of the Series A-II shares and Series A-II units as contemplated by this Agreement. The board of trustees of the REIT and the Manager hereby confirm that all requirements for the issuance of the Series A-II shares of the REIT have been duly satisfied. The OP General Partner hereby confirms that all requirements for the issuance of the Series A-II units of the Operating Partnership have been duly satisfied. 4 4. Representations and Warranties . (a) Each Assignor hereby represents and warrants to the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner and the Operating Partnership, as of the Effective Date, as follows: (i) Immediately prior to the assignments contemplated herein, the REIF III-C Member Interests are owned either directly by the Assignor or beneficially through a custodial account maintained by a custodian or nominee for the benefit of the Assignor pursuant to the REIF III-C Operating Agreement, applicable federal and state securities laws and the terms of the Assignor’s Subscription Agreement. (ii) The Assignor has the right, power and authority to perform its obligations hereunder. The execution, delivery and performance by the Assignor (or its designated representative) of this Agreement have been duly authorized by all necessary action on the part of the Assignor. This Agreement has been duly and validly executed and delivered by the Assignor (or its designated representative) and constitutes the legal, valid and binding obligation of the Assignor, enforceable against the Assignor in accordance with its terms, subject to (A) laws of general application relating to bankruptcy, insolvency and the relief of debtors, and (B) rules of law governing specific performance, injunctive relief and other equitable remedies. (iii) Subject to obtaining the consent of the Manager, the REIF Managing Member, the REIT, the OP General Partner and the Operating Partnership to the transactions contemplated herein, the execution and delivery by the Assignor (or its designated representative) of this Agreement and the consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby by the Assignor (A) are not prohibited by, and will not violate or conflict with, any provision of the organizational documents of the Assignor, and (B) are not prohibited by, and will not violate, any law, rule, regulation or other legal requirement applicable to the Assignor. (iv) No filing with, notice to or consent from any governmental authority is required in connection with (A) the execution, delivery or performance of this Agreement by the Assignor (or its designated representative) or (B) the consummation by the Assignor of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement. (v) Each Assignor owns its REIF III-C Member Interests free and clear of all liens, pledges, security interests, charges, claims, options and other encumbrances (collectively, “ Liens ”) other than (A) restrictions on transfer arising under the REIF III-C Operating Agreement or applicable federal and state securities laws or (B) Liens which shall be extinguished upon consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby, has not sold, assigned, pledged or otherwise transferred any portion thereof, and, upon issuance of the Series A-II shares in the REIT and/or Series A-II units in the Operating Partnership, as applicable, the REIT and the Operating Partnership, as applicable will acquire good and valid title to such REIF III-C Member Interests, free and clear of all Liens other than restrictions on transfer arising under applicable federal and state securities laws. (vi) Each Assignor acquiring Series A-II shares of the REIT, as identified on Schedule 1 of Exhibit A , hereby agrees to become a party to and be bound by all of the provisions of the REIT Governing Materials, as applicable. 5 (vii) Each Assignor acquiring Series A-II shares of the REIT, as identified on Schedule 1 of Exhibit A , hereby makes the representations, warranties and covenants required of a “Subscriber” pursuant to the subscription agreement of the REIT attached hereto as Exhibit D (the “ REIT Subscription Agreement ”) and such representations, warranties and covenants, to the extent applicable, are incorporated herein by reference and deemed to be modified to reflect such Assignor acquiring Series A-II shares pursuant to this Agreement and not a subscription for new shares. (viii) Each Assignor acquiring Series A-II units of the Operating Partnership, as identified on Schedule 2 of Exhibit A , hereby agrees to become a party to and be bound by all of the provisions of the Operating Partnership Agreement, as applicable. (ix) Each Assignor acquiring Series A-II units of the Operating Partnership, as identified on Schedule 2 of Exhibit A , hereby makes the representations, warranties and covenants required of a “Subscriber” pursuant to the subscription agreement of the Operating Partnership attached hereto as Exhibit E (the “ Operating Partnership Subscription Agreement ”) and such representations, warranties and covenants, to the extent applicable, are incorporated herein by reference and deemed to be modified to reflect such Assignor acquiring Series A-II units pursuant to this Agreement and not a subscription for new units. (x) Each Assignor acknowledges and agrees that, in connection with and substantially concurrently with the transactions contemplated by this Agreement, the Exiting Member is not contributing its Investor Member Interests pursuant to this Agreement and is instead disposing of its Investor Member Interests to the REIT pursuant to a separate Purchase, Sale, Assignment and Assumption Agreement (the “ Exiting Member PSA ”), and that the contributions, issuances and other transactions contemplated by this Agreement are not affected thereby. Each Assignor has had the opportunity to ask questions regarding the terms of the Exiting Member PSA, consents thereto, and agrees that it shall not have any claim against REIF III-C, the REIF Managing Member, the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner, the Operating Partnership or any of their respective affiliates arising out of or relating to the Exiting Member PSA or the consideration received by any person thereunder, including any difference between the form, amount or value of such consideration and the Series A-II shares in the REIT and/or Series A-II units in the Operating Partnership issued to the Assignors hereunder. (b) The REIF Managing Member hereby represents and warrants to the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner and the Operating Partnership, as of the Effective Date, as follows: (i) Immediately prior to the assignments contemplated herein, the REIF III-C Managing Interest is owned of record and entirely by the REIF Managing Member pursuant to the REIF III-C Operating Agreement. (ii) The REIF Managing Member has the right, power and authority to perform its obligations hereunder. The execution, delivery and performance by the REIF Managing Member of this Agreement have been duly authorized by all necessary action on the part of the REIF Managing Member. This Agreement has been duly and validly executed and delivered by the REIF Managing Member and constitutes the legal, valid and binding obligation of the REIF Managing Member, enforceable against the REIF Managing Member in accordance with its terms, subject to (A) laws of general application relating to bankruptcy, insolvency and the relief of debtors, and (B) rules of law governing specific performance, injunctive relief and other equitable remedies. (iii) Subject to obtaining the consent of the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner and the Operating Partnership to the transactions contemplated herein, the execution and delivery by the REIF Managing Member of this Agreement and the consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby by the REIF Managing Member (A) are not prohibited by, and will not violate or conflict with, any provision of the organizational documents of the REIF Managing Member, and (B) are not prohibited by, and will not violate, any law, rule, regulation or other legal requirement applicable to the REIF Managing Member. 6 (iv) No filing with, notice to or consent from any governmental authority is required in connection with (A) the execution, delivery or performance of this Agreement by the REIF Managing Member or (B) the consummation by the REIF Managing Member of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement. (c) The REIF Managing Member further represents and warrants, solely in its capacity as managing member of REIF III-C and on behalf of REIF III-C, to the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner, the Operating Partnership and the Assignors, as of the Effective Date, as follows: (i) REIF III-C is a limited liability company duly formed, validly existing and in good standing under the laws of the State of Delaware and has all requisite limited liability company power and authority to own its assets and to carry on its business as currently conducted in all material respects. (ii) The REIF III-C Member Interests and the REIF III-C Managing Interest have been duly authorized and validly issued in accordance with the REIF III-C Operating Agreement and together constitute all of the issued and outstanding equity interests in REIF III-C. Except as set forth in the REIF III-C Operating Agreement or the Subscription Agreements, there are no outstanding options, warrants, rights, convertible or exchangeable securities, subscriptions, commitments or other agreements obligating REIF III-C to issue, sell, repurchase or redeem any equity interests in REIF III-C. (iii) REIF III-C has good and valid title to each of the Investments (as defined in the REIF III-C Operating Agreement) held by REIF III-C, free and clear of all Liens other than (A) Liens for taxes not yet due and payable or being contested in good faith, (B) restrictions on transfer arising under applicable federal and state securities laws, (C) Liens arising under the organizational or governing documents of the applicable issuer or obligor of any Investment of REIF III-C or under the REIF III-C Operating Agreement, (D) Liens securing any indebtedness or credit facility of REIF III-C or any issuer or obligor of an Investment, in each case disclosed to the Manager, and (E) other Liens that would not, individually or in the aggregate, reasonably be expected to materially impair the value of the Investments, taken as a whole. (iv) There is no action, suit, claim, proceeding, arbitration or investigation pending or, to the knowledge of the REIF Managing Member, threatened in writing against REIF III-C, any REIF III-C Covered Person (as defined in Section 5(f)) in its capacity as such or, to the knowledge of the REIF Managing Member, any of the Investments held by REIF III-C that (A) would reasonably be expected to be material to REIF III-C, or (B) challenges or seeks to prevent, enjoin or materially delay the transactions contemplated by this Agreement, and, to the knowledge of the REIF Managing Member, no facts or circumstances exist that would reasonably be expected to give rise to any such action, suit, claim, proceeding, arbitration or investigation or would otherwise result in any obligation of an Assignor to make a Member Giveback. Neither REIF III-C nor, to the knowledge of the REIF Managing Member, any of the Investments held by REIF III-C is subject to any outstanding order, judgment, injunction or decree of any governmental authority that is material to REIF III-C. (v) To the knowledge of the REIF Managing Member, REIF III-C has been operated and managed in all material respects in accordance with applicable law and the REIF III-C Operating Agreement, except for such failures as would not, individually or in the aggregate, reasonably be expected to be material to REIF III-C. 7 (d) The REIT represents and warrants to the Operating Partnership, the OP General Partner, the REIF Managing Member and the Assignors identified on Exhibit A , as of the Effective Date, as follows: (i) The REIT has the right, power and authority to perform its obligations hereunder. The execution, delivery and performance by the REIT of this Agreement have been duly authorized by all necessary action on the part of the REIT. This Agreement has been duly and validly executed and delivered by the REIT and constitutes the legal, valid and binding obligation of the REIT, enforceable against the REIT in accordance with its terms, subject to (A) laws of general application relating to bankruptcy, insolvency and the relief of debtors, and (B) rules of law governing specific performance, injunctive relief and other equitable remedies. (ii) Subject to obtaining the consent of the OP General Partner and the Operating Partnership to the transactions contemplated herein, the execution and delivery by the REIT of this Agreement and the consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby by the REIT (A) are not prohibited by, and will not violate or conflict with, any provision of the organizational documents of the REIT or the Operating Partnership, and (B) are not prohibited by, and will not violate, any law, rule, regulation or other legal requirement applicable to the REIT. (iii) No filing with, notice to or consent from any governmental authority is required in connection with (A) the execution, delivery or performance of this Agreement by the REIT or (B) the consummation by the REIT of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement. (e) The Operating Partnership represents and warrants to the REIT, the Manager and the Assignors identified on Exhibit A , as of the Effective Date, as follows: (i) The Operating Partnership has the right, power and authority to perform its obligations hereunder. The execution, delivery and performance by the Operating Partnership of this Agreement have been duly authorized by all necessary action on the part of the Operating Partnership. This Agreement has been duly and validly executed and delivered by the Operating Partnership and constitutes the legal, valid and binding obligation of the Operating Partnership, enforceable against the Operating Partnership in accordance with its terms, subject to (A) laws of general application relating to bankruptcy, insolvency and the relief of debtors, and (B) rules of law governing specific performance, injunctive relief and other equitable remedies. (ii) Subject to obtaining the consent of the REIT and the Manager to the transactions contemplated herein, the execution and delivery by the Operating Partnership of this Agreement and the consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby by the Operating Partnership (A) are not prohibited by, and will not violate or conflict with, any provision of the organizational documents of the Operating Partnership or the REIT, and (B) are not prohibited by, and will not violate, any law, rule, regulation or other legal requirement applicable to the Operating Partnership. (iii) No filing with, notice to or consent from any governmental authority is required in connection with (A) the execution, delivery or performance of this Agreement by the Operating Partnership or (B) the consummation by the Operating Partnership of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement. 8 (f) Each Assignor has concluded its own independent evaluation and made its own analysis as it has deemed necessary, prudent or advisable in order for it to make its own determination and decision to contribute the REIF III-C Member Interests to the REIT and the Operating Partnership, as applicable, and to acquire Series A-II shares and Series A-II units, as applicable, as contemplated herein, and to enter into this Agreement and consummate the transactions contemplated hereby. Each Assignor is entering into this Agreement and the transactions contemplated hereby relying entirely upon such independent evaluation and analysis and without reliance upon any representations or warranties of any kind or nature (except as set forth herein or in the REIT Governing Materials) or other information (in each case, whether oral or written) from the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner, the Operating Partnership, any of their affiliates or any of their partners, employees, agents, directors, officers, members, managers, representatives or advisors. (g) The REIF Managing Member has concluded its own independent evaluation and made its own analysis as it has deemed necessary, prudent or advisable in order for it to make its own determination and decision to contribute the REIF III-C Managing Interest to the REIT and to enter into this Agreement and consummate the transactions contemplated hereby. The REIF Managing Member is entering into this Agreement and the transactions contemplated hereby relying entirely upon such independent evaluation and analysis and without reliance upon any representations or warranties of any kind or nature (except as set forth herein or in the REIT Governing Materials) or other information (in each case, whether oral or written) from the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner, the Operating Partnership, any of their affiliates or any of their partners, employees, agents, directors, officers, members, managers, representatives or advisors. (h) Each Assignor hereby releases and discharges the REIF Managing Member, REIF III-C, the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner, the Operating Partnership and each of their affiliates, from any and all claims, demands, suits, liabilities, obligations, judgments, orders, debts, liens and causes of action of every kind and nature, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, concealed or hidden, vested or contingent, in law or equity, existing by statute, common law, contract or otherwise, which have existed, may exist in the future or do exist now, arising from or relating in any way to: (i) the assignments and assumptions contemplated in this Agreement; (ii) the consents of the Manager and the OP General Partner to the assignments and assumptions contemplated in this Agreement; (iii) any valuation and/or other data or information provided in good faith by the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner, the Operating Partnership, any of their affiliates or any of their partners, employees, agents, directors, officers, members, managers, representatives or advisors (other than data or information arising out of gross negligence, willful malfeasance or fraud of the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner, the Operating Partnership, any of their affiliates or any of their partners, employees, agents, directors, officers, members, managers, representatives or advisors); and (iv) any involvement by the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner or the Operating Partnership in the assignments and assumptions contemplated in this Agreement, including, to the extent applicable, any facilitating or assisting with such transactions. For the avoidance of doubt, in no event shall the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner, the Operating Partnership, any of their affiliates or any of their partners, employees, agents, directors, officers, members, managers, representatives or advisors be released or discharged from their obligations under this Agreement or their duties under the REIF III-C Operating Agreement or at law owed to the Assignors prior to the Effective Date. 5. Indemnity . (a) Assignors . Each Assignor, on a several and not joint basis, agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the Manager, the REIT, the OP General Partner, the Operating Partnership, any of their affiliates or any of their partners, employees, agents, directors, officers, members, managers, representatives or advisors (collectively, the “ REIT Indemnified Parties ”) against any losses, claims, damages, liabilities or expenses to which any REIT Indemnified Party may become subject arising out of or based upon any false representation or warranty made by, or breach or failure to comply with any covenant or agreement of, such Assignor herein, subject to the terms and limitations set forth in this Section 5. 9 (b) REIF Managing Member . The REIF Managing Member agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the REIT Indemnified Parties against any losses, claims, damages, liabilities or expenses to which any REIT Indemnified Party may become subject arising out of or based upon any false representation or warranty made by the REIF Managing Member herein or any breach or failure to comply with any covenant or agreement of the REIF Managing Member herein, subject to the terms and limitations set forth in this Section 5. (c) Survival . The representations and warranties of the Assignors and the REIF Managing Member set forth herein, and the right of any REIT Indemnified Party to make a claim under this Section 5 with respect thereto, shall survive the Effective Date until the date that is twelve (12) months following the Effective Date; provided, however, that the representations and warranties set forth in Sections 4(a) and 4(b) hereof, and the right of any REIT Indemnified Party to make a claim under this Section 5 with respect thereto shall survive the Effective Date until the date that is thirty-six (36) months following the Effective Date. Notwithstanding the foregoing, any claim asserted in good faith and with reasonable specificity in a written notice delivered to the applicable indemnifying party prior to the expiration of the applicable survival period shall survive until such claim is finally resolved. The parties specifically intend that the survival period set forth in this Section 5(c) shall replace any statute of limitations that would otherwise be applicable. (d) Limitations . Notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, the indemnification obligations of (A) each Assignor under Section 5(a) with respect to the representations and warranties of such Assignor set forth herein and (B) the REIF Managing Member under Section 5(b) with respect to the representations and warranties set forth in Section 4(c) hereof shall be subject to the following limitations: (i) Cap . The aggregate liability of (A) each Assignor for losses arising out of any inaccuracy in or breach of any representation or warranty of such Assignor set forth in Section 4(a) shall not exceed an amount equal to ten percent (10%) of the aggregate value of the consideration being issued to such Assignor pursuant to Section 1 of this Agreement, and (B) the REIF Managing Member for losses arising out of any inaccuracy in or breach of any representation or warranty of the REIF Managing Member set forth in Section 4(c) shall not exceed an amount equal to ten percent (10%) of the aggregate value of the consideration being issued to the Assignors and the REIF Managing Member pursuant to Section 1 of this Agreement. (ii) Exceptions . None of the limitations set forth in this Section 5(d) shall apply to losses arising out of fraud, willful misconduct, gross negligence, bad faith, any material violation of applicable law or material breach of the REIF III-C Operating Agreement by the applicable indemnifying party. (iii) Calculation of Losses . The amount of any losses shall be calculated net of any insurance proceeds and any indemnity, contribution or similar payments actually recovered by the REIT Indemnified Parties from third parties in respect of such losses, and no REIT Indemnified Party shall be entitled to recover more than once in respect of the same loss. (e) Exclusive Remedy . From and after the Effective Date, except in the case of fraud and except for claims for specific performance, injunctive relief or other equitable remedies, the indemnification provided in this Section 5 shall be the sole and exclusive remedy of the REIT Indemnified Parties with respect to any inaccuracy in or breach by an Assignor or the REIF Managing Member (as applicable) of any representation, warranty, covenant or agreement contained in this Agreement. In no event shall the REIF Managing Member or any Assignor be liable for punitive or exemplary damages, except to the extent actually paid to a third party. Notwithstanding the foregoing, this Section 5(e) shall not apply to, nor limit any rights or remedies of, any Assignor. 10 (f) Continued Indemnification of the REIF Managing Member . Notwithstanding the transactions contemplated by Section 1 or any subsequent dissolution, liquidation, merger or other reorganization of REIF III-C, the REIF Managing Member, its affiliates and each other person entitled to indemnification, exculpation or advancement of expenses under the REIF III-C Operating Agreement (each, a “ REIF III-C Covered Person ”) shall continue to be entitled to indemnification, exculpation and advancement of expenses from REIF III-C on the same terms, subject to the same conditions and limitations, and to the same extent as provided in the REIF III-C Operating Agreement as in effect immediately prior to the Effective Date, as if REIF III-C continued to exist and the REIF III-C Operating Agreement as in effect immediately prior to the Effective Date continued in effect thereafter, with respect to any acts or omissions occurring, or matters arising out of facts or circumstances existing, at or prior to the Effective Date (including the approval and consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby and the representations and warranties made herein); provided, however, that the assets available to REIF III-C to indemnify the REIF Managing Member pursuant to the foregoing shall be limited to the proceeds of any Member Giveback, which, for the avoidance of doubt, shall be Excluded Obligations retained by the Assignors. In furtherance of the foregoing, each Assignor hereby acknowledges and agrees that each Assignor is retaining its Member Giveback obligations as in effect immediately prior to the Effective Date under the REIF III-C Operating Agreement, as if REIF III-C continued to exist and the REIF III-C Operating Agreement as in effect immediately prior to the Effective Date continued in effect thereafter. (g) Third-Party Claims . Any REIT Indemnified Party seeking indemnification hereunder in respect of a claim asserted by a third party shall give prompt written notice thereof to the indemnifying party (provided that, failure to give such notice shall not relieve the indemnifying party of its obligations except to the extent it is prejudiced thereby). The indemnifying party shall be entitled to assume and control the defense of such claim with counsel reasonably acceptable to the REIT Indemnified Party, and the REIT Indemnified Party shall reasonably cooperate in such defense. No REIT Indemnified Party shall settle or compromise any such claim without the prior written consent of the indemnifying party (not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed), and the indemnifying party shall not settle any such claim without the consent of the REIT Indemnified Party unless such settlement involves only the payment of money damages that are fully indemnified hereunder and includes a full release of the REIT Indemnified Party. 6. Tax Matters. (a) For all applicable income tax purposes, the transactions contemplated by Section 1 of this Agreement will be treated by the parties hereto as a sale of partnership interests in REIF III-C to the REIT and the Operating Partnership, as applicable, pursuant to sections 351(e) and 721(b) of the Internal Revenue Code, as applicable (the “ Agreed Tax Treatment ”). None of the parties to this Agreement shall take any position for income tax purposes (whether in audits, tax returns or otherwise) which is inconsistent with the Agreed Tax Treatment unless required to do so by a “determination” within the meaning of Section 1313(a) of the Internal Revenue Code. (b) REIF III-C, through the REIF Managing Member, shall, as of the Effective Date, complete the certification attached as Exhibit G hereto in order to prevent any withholding obligation on the part of the REIT or the Operating Partnership in connection with the Agreed Tax Treatment. 11 7. Expenses . The REIT agrees to pay and/or reimburse, or cause to be paid and/or reimbursed, the Manager for all reasonable and documented expenses, including reasonable attorney’s fees and expenses, incurred by the Manager in connection with the preparation and negotiation of this Agreement. 8. Further Assurances . Each of the parties hereto shall execute and cause to be delivered to the other party hereto such instruments and other documents, and shall take such other actions, as such other party may reasonably request for the purpose of carrying out or evidencing any of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement. 9. Amendments . This Agreement may not be amended, modified, altered or supplemented other than by means of a written instrument duly executed and delivered on behalf of all of the parties hereto. 10. Governing Law . This Agreement and all rights and obligations arising hereunder shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the laws of the State of Delaware, without giving effect to the provisions, policies or principles thereof relating to choice or conflicts of law. TO THE EXTENT NOT PROHIBITED BY APPLICABLE LAW WHICH CANNOT BE WAIVED, EACH PARTY HERETO HEREBY WAIVES AND COVENANTS THAT IT SHALL NOT ASSERT (WHETHER AS PLAINTIFF, DEFENDANT OR OTHERWISE) ANY RIGHT TO TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY FORUM IN RESPECT OF ANY ISSUE OR ACTION, CLAIM, CAUSE OF ACTION OR SUIT (IN CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE), INQUIRY, PROCEEDING OR INVESTIGATION ARISING OUT OF OR BASED UPON THIS AGREEMENT OR THE SUBJECT MATTER HEREOF OR IN ANY WAY CONNECTED WITH OR RELATED OR INCIDENTAL TO THE TRANSACTIONS CONTEMPLATED HEREBY, IN EACH CASE WHETHER NOW EXISTING OR HEREAFTER ARISING. EACH PARTY HERETO ACKNOWLEDGES THAT IT HAS BEEN INFORMED BY THE OTHER PARTIES HERETO THAT THIS SECTION 10 CONSTITUTES A MATERIAL INDUCEMENT UPON WHICH THEY ARE RELYING AND SHALL RELY IN ENTERING INTO THIS AGREEMENT. ANY PARTY HERETO MAY FILE AN ORIGINAL COUNTERPART OR A COPY OF THIS SECTION 10 WITH ANY COURT AS WRITTEN EVIDENCE OF THE CONSENT OF EACH SUCH PARTY TO THE WAIVER OF ITS RIGHT TO TRIAL BY JURY. 11. Counterparts and Electronic Delivery . This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which, taken together, shall constitute one and the same instrument. Delivery of an executed signature page of this Agreement by electronic mail in portable document format (PDF) will be effective as delivery of a manually executed signature page of this Agreement. 12. Severability . If any provisions of this Agreement are determined to be invalid, illegal or unenforceable by any governmental entity, the remaining provisions of this Agreement, to the extent permitted by law, shall remain in full force and effect. 13. Entire Agreement . Except as otherwise expressly provided herein, this Agreement constitutes the sole and entire agreement of the parties to this Agreement with respect to the subject matter contained herein, and supersedes all prior and contemporaneous understandings, representations and warranties and agreements, both written and oral, with respect to such subject matter. 14. No Waiver. No waiver by any party of any of the provisions of this Agreement shall be effective unless explicitly set forth in writing and signed by the party so waiving. Except as otherwise set forth in this Agreement, no failure to exercise, or delay in exercising, any right, remedy, power, or privilege arising from this Agreement shall operate or be construed as a waiver thereof; nor shall any single or partial exercise of any right, remedy, power, or privilege hereunder preclude any other or further exercise thereof or the exercise of any other right, remedy, power, or privilege. 12 15. Interpretation; Headings . Every term and provision of this Agreement shall be construed simply according to its fair meaning and not strictly for or against any party. All headings herein are inserted only for convenience and ease of reference and are not to be considered in the construction or interpretation of any provision of this Agreement. text: EX-10.5 10 tm2630475d1_ex10-5.htm EXHIBIT 10.5 Exhibit 10.5 CONTRIBUTION AND ISSUANCE AGREEMENT This Contribution and Issuance Agreement (this “ Agreement ”), effective as of November 19, 2026 (the “ Effective Date ”), is by and among each investor whose name is set forth on Exhibit A (each an “ Assignor ” and collectively the “ Assignors ”), Angel Oak Real Estate Investment Fund IV-C LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (“ REIF IV-C ”), its managing member, Angel Oak Capital Partners II, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (“ REIF Managing Member ”), Angel Oak Residential Evergreen Trust, a Maryland statutory trust (the “ REIT ”), Angel Oak Residential Evergreen Operating Partnership L.P., a Delaware limited partnership (the “ Operating Partnership ”), AO Residential Evergreen OP GP, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and the general partner of the Operating Partnership (the “ OP General Partner ”), and Angel Oak Capital Advisors, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and manager for each of the REIT, the Operating Partnership and REIF IV-C (the “ Manager ”). WHEREAS, the Assignors, collectively, own all “Investor Member Interests” in REIF IV-C, other than the Investor Member Interests held by that certain investor member of REIF IV-C that is not a party to this Agreement (the “ Exiting Member ”) (the Investor Member Interests held by the Assignors, collectively the “ REIF IV-C Member Interests ”), pursuant to that certain limited liability company agreement of REIF IV-C (as amended and restated through the date hereof and attached hereto as Exhibit F , the “ REIF IV-C Operating Agreement ”) and those certain Subscription Agreements by and between each Assignor, REIF IV-C and the REIF Managing Member (together with any assignment agreements or other modifications to such subscription agreements, the “ Subscription Agreements ”); WHEREAS, the REIF Managing Member owns all “Managing Member Interests” in REIF IV-C (the “ REIF IV-C Managing Interest ”) pursuant to the REIF IV-C Operating Agreement; WHEREAS, the Assignors desire to contribute 100% of the REIF IV-C Member Interests to the REIT and/or the Operating Partnership in exchange for Series A-II shares in the REIT and/or Series A-II units in the Operating Partnership, as applicable, as set forth on Exhibit A , and the REIT and the Operating Partnership, as applicable, desire to accept the REIF IV-C Member Interests, in each case subject to the terms and provisions of this Agreement, the Confidential Private Placement Memorandum of the REIT (as amended, modified, supplemented or restated from time to time, the “ Memorandum ”), the Amended and Restated Declaration of Trust of the REIT (as amended, modified, supplemented or restated from time to time, the “ Declaration of Trust ”), the Bylaws of the REIT (as amended, modified, supplemented or restated from time to time, the “ Bylaws ”, and together with the Memorandum and the Declaration of Trust, the “ REIT Governing Materials ”) attached hereto as Exhibit B and the Limited Partnership Agreement of the Operating Partnership (as amended, modified, supplemented or restated from time to time, the “ Operating Partnership Agreement ”) attached hereto as Exhibit C ; WHEREAS, the REIF Managing Member desires to contribute 100% of the REIF IV-C Managing Interest to the REIT in exchange for release of its obligations as managing member of REIF IV-C, except as provided herein, and the REIT desires to accept the REIF IV-C Managing Interest under such terms, in each case subject to the terms and provisions of this Agreement and the REIT Governing Materials; 1 WHEREAS, the REIT desires to contribute 100% of the received REIF IV-C Member Interests and REIF IV-C Managing Interest to the Operating Partnership in exchange for limited partner interests in the Operating Partnership, and the Operating Partnership desires to accept the REIF IV-C Member Interests and REIF IV-C Managing Interest, in each case subject to the terms and provisions of this Agreement and the Operating Partnership Agreement; WHEREAS, the board of trustees of the REIT, the Manager and the OP General Partner desire to consent to the contributions and assignments of the REIF IV-C Member Interests and REIF IV-C Managing Interest contemplated herein; WHEREAS, following such assignments, (i) Assignors will own Series A-II shares in the REIT and/or Series A-II units in the Operating Partnership, as applicable and described on Exhibit A , (ii) the REIT will own limited partner interests in the Operating Partnership, and (iii) the Operating Partnership will own the REIF IV-C Member Interests and REIF IV-C Managing Interest; WHEREAS, in connection with this Agreement, the Manager has provided that certain Letter Agreement for the benefit of the Assignors (as executed in connection with this Agreement, the “ Letter Agreement ”) attached hereto as Exhibit H . NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements herein made and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, and intending to be legally bound, the parties hereto agree as follows: 1. Contribution and Issuance . (a) REIF IV-C Member Interests to REIT. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which, taken together, shall constitute one and the same instrument. Delivery of an executed signature page of this Agreement by electronic mail in portable document format (PDF) will be effective as delivery of a manually executed signature page of this Agreement. 12. Severability . If any provisions of this Agreement are determined to be invalid, illegal or unenforceable by any governmental entity, the remaining provisions of this Agreement, to the extent permitted by law, shall remain in full force and effect. 13. Entire Agreement . Except as otherwise expressly provided herein, this Agreement constitutes the sole and entire agreement of the parties to this Agreement with respect to the subject matter contained herein, and supersedes all prior and contemporaneous understandings, representations and warranties and agreements, both written and oral, with respect to such subject matter. 14. No Waiver. No waiver by any party of any of the provisions of this Agreement shall be effective unless explicitly set forth in writing and signed by the party so waiving. Except as otherwise set forth in this Agreement, no failure to exercise, or delay in exercising, any right, remedy, power, or privilege arising from this Agreement shall operate or be construed as a waiver thereof; nor shall any single or partial exercise of any right, remedy, power, or privilege hereunder preclude any other or further exercise thereof or the exercise of any other right, remedy, power, or privilege. 12 15. Interpretation; Headings . Every term and provision of this Agreement shall be construed simply according to its fair meaning and not strictly for or against any party. All headings herein are inserted only for convenience and ease of reference and are not to be considered in the construction or interpretation of any provision of this Agreement. title: Nissan Auto Lease Trust 2026-C
text: EX-10.1 3 d37708dex101.htm EX-10.1 EX-10.1 Exhibit 10.1 NISSAN-INFINITI LT LLC 2026-C SERIES SUPPLEMENT November 24, 2026 To: U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, as Titling Company Registrar of Nissan-Infiniti LT LLC (the “ Company ”) Re: Designation of 2026-C Series Interest cc: U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, not in its individual capacity, but as Indenture Trustee, as Registered Pledgee; Nissan Motor Acceptance Company LLC, as Titling Company Administrator Reference is made to the Limited Liability Company Agreement of the Company, dated as of April 1, 2021 (as amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified and in effect from time to time, the “ Titling Company Agreement ”), between NILT LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, as member of the Company (in such capacity, the “ Member ”), Nissan Motor Acceptance Company LLC (“ NMAC ”), a Delaware limited liability company, as administrator (in such capacity, the “ Titling Company Administrator ”), and U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, a national banking association, as Titling Company Registrar (in such capacity, the “ Titling Company Registrar ”). Unless otherwise defined herein, all capitalized terms will have the meanings ascribed thereto in Annex A to the Series Certificate Sale Agreement, dated as of the date hereof, by and between NILT LLC and Nissan Auto Leasing LLC II (as amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified and in effect from time to time, the “ Series Certificate Sale Agreement ”), and, if not defined therein, will have the meanings ascribed thereto in the Titling Company Agreement, which also contains rules as to usage that are applicable herein. 1. Pursuant to Section 4.1(a) of the Titling Company Agreement, a new Series Interest, to be known as the “Nissan-Infiniti LT LLC - 2026-C Series Interest” (the “ 2026-C Series Interest ”) is hereby established and formed, and there shall be issued a Certificate representing the 2026-C Series Interest (the “ 2026-C Series Certificate ”), substantially in the form of Exhibit A , representing the entire 2026-C Series Interest. The 2026-C Series Interest shall have the Series Assets allocated to and associated with from time to time such Series Interest and listed in the Schedule of 2026-C Series Assets (the “ 2026-C Series Assets ”). 2. The 2026-C Series Interest is a separate protected series of the Company within the meaning of Section 18-215(b) of the Act. 3. Pursuant to Section 4.1(c)(i) of the Titling Company Agreement, the Series Issue Date of the 2026-C Series Interest is November 24, 2026 (the “ 2026-C Series Issue Date ”). 4. Pursuant to Section 4.1(c)(iv) of the Titling Company Agreement, Nissan Auto Lease Trust 2026-C is designated as the registered Holder of the entire 2026-C Series Interest as of the 2026-C Series Issue Date. You are directed to authenticate, as of the 2026-C Series Issue Date, the following Series Certificates: (i) the initial 2026-C Series Certificate issued to NILT LLC designated as 2026-C Series Certificate No. 1, which will represent the entire 2026-C Series 1 NALT 2026-C Series Supplement Interest (the “ Initial 2026-C Series Certificate ”); (ii) immediately thereafter, the 2026-C Series Certificate issued to Nissan Auto Leasing LLC II designated as 2026-C Series Certificate No. 2, which will represent the entire 2026-C Series Interest (the “ Depositor 2026-C Series Certificate ”); and (iii) immediately thereafter, the final 2026-C Series Certificate issued to the Issuing Entity designated as 2026-C Series Certificate No. 3, which will represent the entire 2026-C Series Interest. The Initial 2026-C Series Certificate and Depositor 2026-C Series Certificate shall be submitted for cancellation pursuant to Section 5.4(c) of the Titling Company Agreement. For purposes of transfer of the Initial 2026-C Series Certificate to Nissan Auto Leasing LLC II and the transfer of the Depositor 2026-C Series Certificate to the Issuing Entity on the date hereof, the instruments of transfer and certifications regarding representations and warranties referenced in Sections 5.4(a) and 5.4(e) of the Titling Company Agreement shall not be required. 5. The 2026-C Series Interest is a Fixed Series Interest. 6. The 2026-C Series Certificate is issued as a single class. 7. Pursuant to Section 4.1(c)(v) of the Titling Company Agreement, the Series Cutoff Date for the 2026-C Series Interest will be October 31, 2026. 8. Rights in Respect of the 2026-C Series Interest . Each Holder and Registered Pledgee of the 2026-C Series Certificate is a third-party beneficiary of this 2026-C Series Supplement and the Titling Company Agreement insofar as this 2026-C Series Supplement and the Titling Company Agreement apply to the 2026-C Series Interest, the Holders of the 2026-C Series Certificate and the Registered Pledgees of the 2026-C Series Certificate. Therefore, references in the Titling Company Agreement to the ability of a “Holder” or a “Registered Pledgee” of a Series Certificate to take any action shall be deemed to refer to the Indenture Trustee (as Registered Pledgee of the 2026-C Series Certificate), acting at the direction of the Required Percentage of the Noteholders and thereafter, the Owner Trustee, acting at the direction of the Required Percentage of the Trust Certificateholders (which for this purpose shall include the Trust Certificates owned by the Issuing Entity, the Depositor, the Servicer (so long as NMAC or an Affiliate is the Servicer) and any of their respective Affiliates) until the final distribution is made with respect to the 2026-C Series Assets. 9. Transfer Restrictions . (a) The 2026-C Series Certificate (or the 2026-C Series Interest represented thereby) may not be acquired or held by or on behalf of any Benefit Plan Investor. The 2026-C Series Certificate (or the 2026-C Series Interest represented thereby) may not be acquired or held by or on behalf of a Plan that is subject to Similar Law if the acquisition, holding and disposition of the 2026-C Series Certificate (or the 2026-C Series Interest represented thereby) would result in a violation of Similar Law or would result in the assets of the Company being (i) considered plan assets of such Plan or (ii) subject to Similar Law. 2 NALT 2026-C Series Supplement (b) Notwithstanding any other provision herein, no transfer or assignment of the 2026-C Series Certificate or the 2026-C Series Interest represented thereby (other than transfers or assignments to the Depositor or the Issuing Entity and the related pledge to the Indenture Trustee) will be valid, and any such purported transfer or assignment shall, to the fullest extent permitted by law, be deemed null, void, and of no effect herewith, unless the purported transferee first shall have certified in writing to the Titling Company and the Titling Company Administrator that, for U.S. federal income tax purposes, the transferee is not a partnership, S Corporation (as defined in the Code), or grantor trust having more than one beneficial owner or having a single beneficial owner that is a partnership or S Corporation. 10. 2026-C Series Collection Account . (a) With respect to the 2026-C Series Interest, the Servicer, on or prior to the Closing Date, shall establish and maintain in the name of the Registered Pledgee until the Outstanding Amount of the Notes is zero, and thereafter in the name of the Holder, the 2026-C Series Collection Account (the “ 2026-C Series Collection Account ”). The 2026-C Series Collection Account shall be initially established with the Registered Pledgee. If the 2026-C Series Collection Account shall cease to be an Eligible Account or if the Servicer, in its sole discretion, notifies the Registered Pledgee in writing that the 2026-C Series Collection Account should be moved, then the Servicer shall, with the assistance of the Registered Pledgee, as necessary, cause such 2026-C Series Collection Account to be moved to an alternate institution selected by the Servicer. The 2026-C Series Collection Account shall be related solely to the 2026-C Series and the 2026-C Series Assets, and funds therein shall not be commingled with any other monies, except as otherwise provided for in, or contemplated by, the Titling Company Agreement or in the Servicing Agreement. All deposits into the 2026-C Series Collection Account shall be made as described in the Servicing Agreement. (b) On each Deposit Date and Payment Date, pursuant to the instructions from the Servicer, the Registered Pledgee shall make deposits and withdrawals from the 2026-C Series Collection Account as set forth in the 2026-C Servicing Supplement. (c) Any transfer of funds to a Holder of a 2026-C Series Certificate shall be made as directed pursuant to the Basic Documents. (d) If, at any time, the 2026-C Series Collection Account or the Reserve Account ceases to be an Eligible Account, the Indenture Trustee (or the Servicer on its behalf) within thirty (30) calendar days (or any longer period if the Rating Agency Condition is satisfied with respect to such longer period), shall establish a new Eligible Account meeting the conditions specified above and transfer (or direct the Indenture Trustee to transfer) any monies, instruments, securities, security entitlements, documents, certificates of deposit and other property to such new Eligible Account. The Indenture Trustee or the Owner Trustee, as applicable, shall assist the Servicer with the moving of the 2026-C Series Collection Account and the Reserve Account as described in the preceding sentence. 3 NALT 2026-C Series Supplement 11. 2026-C Reserve Account . Pursuant to Section 5.01(b) of the Trust Agreement, the Servicer, on behalf of the Issuing Entity, on or prior to the Closing Date, shall establish and maintain the Reserve Account (i) with the Indenture Trustee, until the Outstanding Amount is reduced to zero, and (ii) thereafter with the Owner Trustee. Deposits to and withdrawals from the Reserve Account shall be made as directed pursuant to the Basic Documents, including Section 8.04(c) of the Indenture, Section 8.03 of the 2026-C Servicing Supplement and Section 12 of this 2026-C Series Supplement. 12. Investment of Monies in 2026-C Series Accounts . All amounts held in the 2026-C Series Collection Account and the Reserve Account shall be invested in Permitted Investments in accordance with Section 8.05(a) of the Indenture. 13. Termination of 2026-C Series . (a) If all of the Series Assets allocated to or associated with the 2026-C Series Interest have been liquidated into cash and all such cash shall have been distributed, then, at the direction of the Holder of the 2026-C Series Certificate, the 2026-C Series Interest shall be terminated and the 2026-C Series Certificate shall be returned to the Titling Company Registrar and canceled. (b) Upon a written direction to the Titling Company Administrator from the Holder of the 2026-C Series Certificate (subject to the rights of the Registered Pledgee), the Titling Company Administrator shall (at the expense of the Holder of the 2026-C Series Certificate), subject to the Act, either (i) distribute the 2026-C Series Assets to the Holder of the 2026-C Series Certificate or (ii) allocate the 2026-C Series Assets to, and associate the 2026-C Series Assets with, the Unallocated Assets Series or an Other Series, as directed by such Holder; provided, however, that the 2026-C Series Assets shall not be subject to such distribution or allocation and association prior to the earlier of (x) the acceleration of the Notes under Section 5.02 of the Indenture following an Event of Default or (y) payment in full of principal of, and accrued interest on, the Notes. 14. Amendments . (a) Notwithstanding any provision of the Titling Company Agreement, the Titling Company Agreement, as supplemented by this 2026-C Series Supplement, to the extent that it relates solely to the 2026-C Series, may be amended in accordance with this Section 14 . (b) Any term or provision of this 2026-C Series Supplement may be amended by the Member, without the consent of any other Person, subject to the satisfaction of one of the following conditions: (i) the Member delivers an Officer’s Certificate or Opinion of Counsel to the Indenture Trustee to the effect that such amendment will not materially and adversely affect the interests of the Noteholders; or (ii) the Rating Agency Condition is satisfied with respect to such amendment and the Member notifies the Indenture Trustee in writing that the Rating Agency Condition is satisfied with respect to such amendment. 4 NALT 2026-C Series Supplement (c) This 2026-C Series Supplement may also be amended by the Member (i) for the purpose of adding any provisions to or changing in any manner or eliminating any of the provisions of this 2026-C Series Supplement or of modifying in any manner the rights of the Noteholders with the consent of the holders of Notes evidencing at least a Majority Interest of the Controlling Class of the Notes or (ii) for the purpose of adding any provisions to or changing in any manner or eliminating any of the provisions of this 2026-C Series Supplement or of modifying in any manner the rights of the Trust Certificateholders with the consent of Trust Certificateholders evidencing at least a majority of the beneficial interest in the Trust Certificates. It will not be necessary for the consent of Noteholders or Trust Certificateholders to approve the particular form of any proposed amendment or consent, but it will be sufficient if such consent approves the substance thereof. For purposes of this Section 14 , if NMAC and/or its Affiliates is the holder of Notes representing 100% of the Note Balance of the Outstanding Notes, such Person (or Persons) may consent to such amendment on behalf of the Noteholders. In determining whether NMAC and/or its Affiliates is the holder of Notes representing 100% of the Note Balance of the Outstanding Notes for purposes of the preceding sentence, any party shall be entitled to rely on an Officer’s Certificate or similar certification of NMAC or any Affiliate thereof to such effect. (d) Prior to the execution of any amendment to this 2026-C Series Supplement, the Member shall provide each Rating Agency, the Owner Trustee and the Indenture Trustee with written notice of the substance of such amendment. Promptly after the execution of any amendment to this 2026-C Series Supplement, the Member shall furnish a copy of such amendment to each Rating Agency, the Indenture Trustee and the Owner Trustee. (e) In the event that any Trust Certificates are held by anyone other than NMAC or any of its Affiliates, this 2026-C Series Supplement may only be amended if, in addition, (i) Trust Certificateholders evidencing at least a majority of the beneficial interest in the Trust Certificates consent to such amendment or (ii) such amendment shall not, as evidenced by an Officer’s Certificate of the Titling Company Administrator or an Opinion of Counsel delivered to the Indenture Trustee and the Owner Trustee, materially and adversely affect the interests of the Trust Certificateholders. (f) No amendment pursuant to this Section 14 shall be effective which affects the rights, protections, liabilities or duties of the Titling Company Registrar, the Indenture Trustee and the Owner Trustee without the prior written consent of such Person (which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed). The Titling Company Registrar, the Indenture Trustee and the Owner Trustee may, but shall not be obligated to, enter into any such amendment which adversely affects the Titling Company Registrar’s, the Indenture Trustee’s or the Owner Trustee’s, as applicable, own rights, duties, liabilities or immunities under this 2026-C Series Supplement. (g) Prior to the execution of any amendment to this 2026-C Series Supplement, the Member shall provide an Opinion of Counsel to the Titling Company Registrar to the effect that after such amendment, for U.S. federal income tax purposes, the Company will not be treated as an association (or a publicly traded partnership) taxable as a corporation and the Notes (other than Tax Retained Notes) will properly be characterized as indebtedness. 5 NALT 2026-C Series Supplement 15. Governing Law . THIS 2026-C SERIES SUPPLEMENT WILL BE GOVERNED BY AND CONSTRUED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE LAWS OF THE STATE OF DELAWARE (WITHOUT REGARD TO CONFLICT OF LAWS PRINCIPLES), ALL RIGHTS AND REMEDIES BEING GOVERNED BY SAID LAWS. 16. Series LLC Agreement . For all purposes of the Act, the Titling Company Agreement, together with each Series Supplement (including this 2026-C Series Supplement) and Series Designation Notice, shall constitute the “limited liability company agreement” of the Company within the meaning of the Act. The terms and provisions of each Series Supplement (including this 2026-C Series Supplement) and Series Designation Notice may have the effect of altering, supplementing or amending the terms and provisions of the Titling Company Agreement with respect to the Series governed or established thereby, but shall not alter, supplement or amend the terms of the Titling Company Agreement with respect to any other Series. To the extent that any of the terms or provisions of a Series Supplement or Series Designation Notice conflict with any of the terms or provisions of the Titling Company Agreement, the terms or provisions of such Series Supplement or Series Designation Notice shall control with respect to such Series. The Holder hereby agrees that it is bound by the Titling Company Agreement. 17. Third Party Beneficiaries . Each of the Indenture Trustee and the Owner Trustee shall be a third-party beneficiary hereof with the right to enforce this 2026-C Series Supplement to the same extent as if a party hereto. 18. Limitation on Owner Trustee Liability . It is expressly understood and agreed by the parties hereto that (a) this 2026-C Series Supplement is executed and delivered by Wilmington Trust, National Association (“ WTNA ”), not individually or personally, but solely as Owner Trustee of the Holder, in the exercise of the powers and authority conferred and vested in it, (b) each of the representations, undertakings and agreements herein made on the part of the Holder is made and intended not as a personal representation, undertaking or agreement by WTNA, but is made and intended for the purpose of binding only the Holder, (c) nothing herein contained shall be construed as creating any liability on WTNA, individually or personally, to perform any covenant either expressed or implied contained herein, all such liability, if any, being expressly waived by the parties hereto and by any Person claiming by, through or under the parties hereto, (d) WTNA has made no investigation as to the accuracy or completeness of any representations or warranties made by the Holder or any other Person in this 2026-C Series Supplement and (e) under no circumstances shall WTNA be personally liable for the payment of any indebtedness or expenses of the Holder or be liable for the breach or failure of any obligation, representation, warranty or covenant made or undertaken by the Holder under this 2026-C Series Supplement or any other related documents. 19. Counterparts; Electronic Signatures . This 2026-C Series Supplement may be executed (including by way of electronic or facsimile transmission) in any number of counterparts and by separate parties hereto on separate counterparts, each of which when executed shall be deemed an original, but all counterparts taken together shall constitute one and the same instrument. The parties acknowledge and agree that they may execute this 2026-C Series 6 NALT 2026-C Series Supplement Supplement and any variation or amendment to the same, by electronic instrument. The parties agree that the electronic signatures appearing on the document shall have the same effect as handwritten signatures and the use of an electronic signature on this 2026-C Series Supplement shall have the same validity and legal effect as the use of a signature affixed by hand and is made with the intention of authenticating this 2026-C Series Supplement, and evidencing the parties’ intention to be bound by the terms and conditions contained herein. For the purposes of using an electronic signature, the parties authorize each other to the lawful processing of personal data of the signers for contract performance and their legitimate interests including contract management. 20. Notices . The notice provisions of Section 11.3 of the Titling Company Agreement shall apply equally to this 2026-C Series Supplement. A copy of each notice or other writing required to be delivered pursuant to this 2026-C Series Supplement shall be in writing and, unless otherwise expressly provided herein, shall be deemed to have been duly given or made when delivered by hand or, in the case of mail, email (if an email address is provided) or facsimile notice, when actually received by the intended recipient, and addressed in each case as specified on Schedule II to the Series Certificate Sale Agreement or at such other address as shall be designated by any of the specified addressees in a written notice to the other parties hereto; provided , however , any demand, notice or communication to be delivered pursuant to the Series LLC Agreement to any Rating Agency shall be deemed to be delivered if a copy of such demand, notice or communication has been posted on any web site maintained by NMAC pursuant to a commitment to any Rating Agency relating to the Notes in accordance with 17 C.F.R. 240 17g-5(a)(3). 21. Waiver of Jury Trial; Submission to Jurisdiction . Each of the parties hereto hereby irrevocably and unconditionally: (a) submits for itself and its property in any Proceeding relating to this 2026-C Series Supplement or any documents executed and delivered in connection herewith, or for recognition and enforcement of any judgment in respect thereof, to the nonexclusive general jurisdiction of the courts of the State of Delaware, the courts of the United States of America for the District of Delaware and appellate courts from any thereof; (b) consents that any such Proceeding may be brought and maintained in such courts and waives any objection that it may now or hereafter have to the venue of such Proceeding in any such court or that such Proceeding was brought in an inconvenient court and agrees not to plead or claim the same; (c) agrees that service of process in any such Proceeding may be effected by mailing a copy thereof by registered or certified mail (or any substantially similar form of mail), postage prepaid, to such Person at its address determined in accordance with Section 20 of this 2026-C Series Supplement; (d) agrees that nothing herein shall affect the right to effect service of process in any other manner permitted by law or shall limit the right to sue in any other jurisdiction; and (e) to the extent permitted by applicable law, each party hereto irrevocably waives all right of trial by jury in any Proceeding or counterclaim based on, or arising out of, under or in connection with this 2026-C Series Supplement, any other Basic Document, or any matter arising hereunder or thereunder. 7 NALT 2026-C Series Supplement 22. No Petition . Each of the parties hereto covenants and agrees that prior to the date that is one year and one day after the date upon which all obligations under each Securitized Financing have been paid in full, it will not institute against, or join any other Person in instituting against, the Member, the Depositor, the Titling Company, the Issuing Entity, any other Special Purpose Affiliate or any Beneficiary, any bankruptcy, reorganization, arrangement, insolvency or liquidation Proceeding or other Proceeding under any federal or state bankruptcy or similar law. This Section shall survive the complete or partial termination or assignment of this Agreement.
